jobs.title: IT Field Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Houston, TX — On\-site **Schedule:** Part\-time, approximately 20–25 hours per week to start **Engagement:** Independent Contractor (1099\) **Compensation:** Hourly rate, based on experience **Travel:** Local customer sites with occasional travel within Texas About the Role Binyod is looking for a hands\-on **IT Operations Engineer – Field Service Contractor** to support customers across Houston and, occasionally, other Texas markets. This is a field\-focused role for someone who enjoys troubleshooting technology, working directly with customers, and solving problems on site. You’ll respond to scheduled service tickets, diagnose and resolve first\-level IT and infrastructure issues, document your work, and collaborate with our L2/L3 engineering team when more advanced support is required. Our work spans structured cabling, networks and Wi\-Fi, VoIP, access control, IP cameras, paging, audio\-visual systems, and general IT infrastructure for schools, healthcare organizations, and commercial customers. You don’t need to be an expert in every system we support on day one. We’re looking for strong IT and networking fundamentals, good troubleshooting judgment, disciplined documentation, and a willingness to learn. What You’ll Do You’ll provide on\-site diagnostics and first\-level support for customer IT and low\-voltage infrastructure, including: * Troubleshoot network and Wi\-Fi connectivity, switches, access points, cabling, VLANs, workstations, printers, VoIP phones, UPS systems, and rack power. Perform first\-level repairs such as device swaps, RMA replacements, patching, cable tracing, reboots, firmware updates, configuration restores, and basic reconfiguration. With training, troubleshoot and support access\-control systems, IP cameras/NVRs, paging, and audio\-visual equipment. * Work with remote L2/L3 engineers on complex networking, firewall, VoIP, identity, and system\-configuration issues. * Serve as the remote engineering team’s “eyes and hands” at customer locations. * Capture photos, device model and serial numbers, materials used, time worked, and other information required for every service visit. * Complete service documentation and obtain customer sign\-off before closing tickets. * Escalate work when a repair falls outside the approved scope, requires additional equipment or labor, or needs advanced engineering support. * Support Binyod’s internal office IT when required, including workstation, laptop, phone, printer, network, Wi\-Fi, inventory, and hardware RMA support. * When service volume allows, assist project teams with installation and organization of access points, switches, routers, UPS systems, VoIP phones, NVRs, racks, and related equipment. * What We’re Looking For **Required qualifications:** 3\+ years of hands\-on IT support or infrastructure experience, including work at customer locations. * Practical networking knowledge, including IP addressing, subnets, gateways, DHCP, VLANs, switches, and wireless access points. * Ability to trace and test network cabling. * Strong Windows troubleshooting skills. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and basic Active Directory/Entra user and access concepts. * Comfortable working independently at customer sites, in equipment rooms, and on ladders when required. * Professional and clear communication with customers and internal teams. * Strong documentation habits—you consistently record time, ticket updates, photos, serial numbers, and completed work. * Good troubleshooting judgment and the ability to recognize when an issue should be escalated rather than improvised. * Valid Texas driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle, and smartphone. * Ability to pass a background check and meet applicable Texas DPS registration requirements for access\-control and camera work. * Preferred Experience We’d especially like to hear from candidates with experience in one or more of the following: Access control, CCTV/IP cameras, intrusion systems, paging, or VoIP * Ubiquiti, Cisco, or similar networking platforms * Windows Server and virtualization * Microsoft Intune, SCCM, or endpoint management * IT/security remediation * MSP or field\-service environments * Low\-voltage installation or service * Ticketing and field\-service management systems * CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, OSHA\-10, networking, access\-control, camera, or manufacturer certifications * What Success Looks Like This role requires more than fixing the immediate technical problem. Great service means leaving behind a complete record of what happened. Successful field engineers consistently document their time and work, capture required photos and equipment information, obtain customer sign\-off, close tickets promptly, and escalate advanced issues through the proper support process. The goal is simple: **solve as much as possible on the first visit, document everything, and make the next step clear when escalation is required.** Growth Opportunity This is the first field position in Binyod’s developing Service Department. The position begins at approximately **20–25 hours per week**, with the opportunity to grow into a full\-time role as service volume increases. For the right person, there is also a path toward a **Lead Service Technician** role, with additional exposure and training in networking, VoIP, access control, camera systems, project implementation, and service operations. Contractor Details This position is structured as an **independent contractor (1099\) engagement**. Work is primarily scheduled during normal business hours. After\-hours or weekend assignments are arranged in advance. Work\-related mileage and fuel are compensated according to the contractor agreement. Binyod provides applicable service\-ticket tools and equipment, along with training on company systems and processes. **Interested?** If you’re a hands\-on IT professional who enjoys troubleshooting in the field, working directly with customers, and taking ownership of getting the job properly documented and completed, we’d like to hear from you. Apply with your resume and a brief summary of your hands\-on experience with networking, field IT support, low\-voltage systems, or related infrastructure.

jobs.description: Boston University Information Services \& Technology (IS\&T) is seeking applicants with diverse skills and experiences to join our innovative and inclusive community. Your work will directly support institutional reporting, research, and strategic initiatives. jobs.title: AI Security Engineer / Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **AI Security Engineer / Application Security Engineer** **Location:** Onsite in Seattle, Washington and Sunnyvale, California. Local candidates are required. **Position Type\-** Contract Any Visa Will work Only W2 Pay rate Role Overview We are seeking an experienced **AI Security / Application Security Engineer** to strengthen our security engineering capabilities across application security, cloud services, APIs, and AI/LLM integrations. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in security architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and adversarial testing of AI agents. Key Responsibilities * Conduct **security and privacy design reviews** for applications, APIs, cloud services, engineering proposals, and AI integrations. * Review system architecture, data flows, access controls, trust boundaries, authentication, authorization, and security safeguards. * Perform **threat modeling** for critical services and AI agents, identifying attack surfaces, attack scenarios, attack paths, mitigations, and residual risks. * Conduct hands\-on **security and adversarial testing** of AI/LLM agents, including: * Prompt injection * Tool misuse * Excessive agency * Unauthorized data access * Permission and access\-control issues * External integrations * Sensitive\-data exposure * Identify, validate, and document security vulnerabilities and provide practical remediation recommendations. * Work closely with engineering, security, privacy, and third\-party teams to drive remediation and validate security controls. * Develop reusable security assessment methodologies, checklists, threat models, test cases, and reporting templates. * Support security automation and AI\-assisted security workflows where appropriate. Required Qualifications * **8\+ years of professional experience** in security engineering, application security, product security, offensive security, systems architecture, or a related technical security field. * Experience reviewing complex technical designs and identifying security risks in: * Applications * APIs * Cloud services * Microservices * Distributed systems * Strong understanding of: * Threat modeling * Vulnerability assessment * Risk modeling * Authentication and authorization * Least\-privilege principles * Data protection * Security architecture * Hands\-on experience with security testing, vulnerability investigation, penetration testing, adversarial testing, or security\-control validation. * Strong technical communication skills with the ability to explain security findings to engineering and business stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications * Experience assessing **AI/LLM applications and autonomous AI agents**. * Knowledge of **prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe tool use, excessive agency, and AI data\-security risks**. * Experience with privacy and security design reviews. * Experience securing cloud environments. * Security automation experience using **Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages**. * Familiarity with application\-security frameworks and industry security practices. Key Skills **Application Security \| AI/LLM Security \| Threat Modeling \| Penetration Testing \| Adversarial Testing \| Cloud Security \| API Security \| Security Architecture \| Vulnerability Assessment \| Privacy \& Data Protection \| Python/Go/Bash \| Security Automation** Pay: $50\.00 \- $55\.00 per hour Experience: * AI Security Engineer: 10 years (Preferred) * Application Security Engineer: 10 years (Preferred) * cloud services: 10 years (Preferred) * APIs: 10 years (Preferred) * AI/LLM integration: 10 years (Preferred) * Python: 10 years (Preferred) * Go: 10 years (Preferred) * threat modeling: 10 years (Preferred) * vulnerability assessment: 10 years (Preferred) * penetration testing: 10 years (Preferred) * adversarial testing of AI agents: 10 years (Preferred) * security architecture reviews: 10 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Engineer (EIT/EI) - Land Development
jobs.description: ### **Description** CPH is a multi\-disciplined Engineering and Architectural design firm that ranks in the nation’s Top 500 Design Firms by ENR Magazine. CPH has an opening in its Linthicum Heights, Maryland office for the following position: Project Engineer (EIT/EI) – Land Development. **Hiring Bonus of up to $1,000 for selected candidate!** ### **Duties Include** * Working under a Professional Engineer as a member of a team in the design and preparation of technical reports, analysis/calculations and construction documents. * Preparation of accurate presentation, design, details and construction documents. * Preparation of permit applications and submittal packages to Agencies having jurisdiction. * Coordination with clients, subconsultants, permitting agencies, utility providers, contractors and other parties associated with the project. * Periodic travel to perform site investigations, and construction observation. * Preparation of specifications, shop drawing review, field observations, preparation of inspection reports and other construction administration tasks. * Collaboration with other firm engineers, architects, disciplines, project managers, and business development teams. * Research, interpretation and implementation of relevant codes and client requirements. * Implementation and utilization of CPH and client standards and templates. * Review of documents prepared by others and implementation of project quality control. * Development and adherence to project scope, schedules, and budgets. * Management of clients and national account programs. ### **Requirements** * Ideal candidate will have a B.S. Degree in Civil or Environmental engineering with 1\-5 years of experience in design and permitting of civil/land development projects in Maryland with the ability to model stormwater, design and manage small to large scale land development projects, research and review code requirements, and maintain project schedule \& budget. * CAD experience is desirable. * E.I Certificate or ability to obtain upon starting is required. * Willing to work as a team and have strong organization and communication skills. * Will require intermittent travel to assist with site investigation, construction observation and project transmittals. * Maryland utility design experience a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** * Dependent upon experience. * CPH offers Medical, Dental and Vision with a quality insurance company. * Company Paid Life Insurance and Long\-Term Disability. * 401K, Paid Personal Time Off, and Paid Holidays CPH is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action/Drug Free Work Environment Employer.### **About CPH** CPH is a multi\-disciplined design firm that’s growing quickly across the country. Our diverse team of almost 400 individuals are the heartbeat of our company and the reason for our success. The unique contributions that people bring to our firm sets us apart and allows us to bring exceptional service to the communities and clients we serve. At CPH, we offer small company culture with a big company presence. Founded by three visionaries in 1981, CPH has grown over 40 years to serve a long list of public and private clients across a spectrum of markets. Our comprehensive offering of services and broad reach has provided CPH the opportunity to team with clients in Building Stronger Communities Together across the nation and throughout the Caribbean. CPH is a part of the Trilon Group of companies. Its mission is to bring together North America's best infrastructure consulting firms in a collaborative environment with a People\-First focus to accelerate their ability to deliver smart and sustainable solutions to clients. Through the partnership with Trilon, CPH professionals have the opportunity to network and share best practices with a host of other professionals across the country. Our future is bright, and we need more talented professionals with an entrepreneurial spirit to grow with us! Could this be you?

jobs.title: ATM Field Service Technician
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Customer Engineer **Location:** Chicago, IL, 60691 **Travel:** 100% travel within the Assigned teritory **Payrate:** $22\.80/hr on w2 **Required Availability:** Required to work on rotating shifts, nights, weekends and some holidays. **Job Summary:** Field Service Technician responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining ATM equipment at the module level while ensuring timely issue resolution, accurate reporting, and compliance with safety and security procedures. The role requires strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, problem\-solving skills, customer service focus, and the ability to work independently in a field\-based environment with flexible scheduling and travel requirements. **About CTC:** About company \- Since its founded in 1996, CTC has grown into a trusted global partner in AI \& ML, Enterprise Applications, Digital Services, Managed Services, and Business Services. With headquarters in Detroit, Michigan, CTC has a team of over 2,000 experts worldwide. We empower more than 100 organizations to tackle complex challenges and transform them into sustainable competitive strengths\-\-driving innovation, efficiency, and growth every step of the way. Our strengths have always been Commitment to Customer, Commitment to Colleagues, and Commitment to Community (CTC). **Responsibilities:** * Perform minor maintenance, repairs, and component replacement at the module level. * Maintains parts inventory and related records. * Provides status reports throughout the service repair. * Diagnose problems based on the information provided in the call and through the error logs on the ATM. * Responsible for ownership of customer issues until resolution according to SLA agreements. * Practices security safety procedures when working with ATM's and or within financial institution. * Complete industry specific Training and certifications. * Responsible for accurate and prompt reporting of calls and activity, as well as other reporting as required. **Physical Requirements:** * May require bending/squatting, walking/standing /sitting for prolonged periods. * May require prolonged travel based on your service area. * Carry and or lift a tool kit/parts of varying weights (1\- 50 lbs.) * You may be dispatched daily on a call\-by\-call basis or have a daily schedule. * You may be required to work on rotating shifts, nights, and or weekends. **Basic Qualifications:** * High School Diploma or equivalent 0\-1 years of related experience. * Reliable transportation. * An Android smart phone to receive work orders on and access support documentation. * Have basic tools: Tools are not supplied. \#1 and \#2 flathead and philips screw drivers are most common. **Preferred Qualifications:** * An associate degree is preferred. * Previous experience with ATM or similar equipment is preferred. **This job also can be searched as:** ATM Technician, POS machine maintenance technician, Field service technician, Electro mechanical technician and etc.. Pay: Up to $22\.80 per hour Education: * Associate (Preferred) Experience: * ATM or electro mechanical: 1 year (Required) License/Certification: * Driver's license (Required) Ability to Commute: * Chicago, IL 60691 (Required) Willingness to travel: * 100% (Required) Work Location: On the road

reviews estimates and reports prior to authorizing payments; makes final decisions regarding contract disputes; negotiates and resolves payment claims with contractors; ensures that contractors are advised of schedules required to minimize impact on operations. * Directs and participates in pre\-construction and post\-construction meetings with consultants, contractors, and other parties participating in the construction of airport facilities; jobs.title: Oracle Integration Engineer - Full-time
jobs.description: **Can you make Oracle Fusion and a modern cloud platform work as one — reliably, at scale?** **Do you live and breathe integration, automation and infrastructure\-as\-code?** **Is the sound of working in a fast\-paced, remote\-first environment exciting?** The Dauntless engineering crew is growing. We’re looking for an Oracle integration engineer to deliver the Oracle\-side integration build for a groundbreaking programme delivered for our client. This is a unique opportunity to grow into our team's Oracle specialist — building the integrations that connect Oracle Fusion ERP to a modern, Azure\-hosted dispatch and field\-service platform, along with the automation, deployment pipelines and OCI platform services that make them reliable and repeatable. In this role you will work alongside our Azure DevOps engineer, the Dauntless integration lead, the client’s technical stakeholders and the client’s Oracle ERP partner team to deliver a coherent, well\-integrated and reliable platform. **Who We Are** Dauntless is a full\-service digital agency specialising in digital strategy, design and development. We work with global brands across various industries, delivering everything from small prototypes to large\-scale digital products and software. Our Crew is: * globally distributed * cross\-vertical * industry\-agnostic * multi\-disciplined * digital problem solvers Our purpose is to help growth\-focused companies and industry leaders achieve their goals quickly and efficiently. Combining our strategic approach, relentless creativity and technical expertise, we drive digital transformation and innovation programmes worldwide. **If you are passionate, collaborative, hard\-working, and eager to grow with us, let's talk.** **The Opportunity** We are recruiting an Oracle integration engineer: hands\-on OIC and Fusion experience prioritised over years to own the Oracle\-side integration build on a new programme of work. You will build to integration designs agreed with our integration lead, with clear scope to grow your architectural ownership as the programme matures. More than skills, we’re interested in you as a person and how you will bring the best to the projects you work on and those around you. We love pioneering and making waves, and we have fun while we’re doing all of the above. You should also have a positive, constructive attitude towards clients and appreciate the complexities of managing expectations externally, within a distributed delivery team, and with third\-party partner teams whose platforms we integrate with. **What Makes You Right For This Role?** * You have strong hands\-on experience of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and integrating Oracle Fusion Cloud applications. * You can work as the day\-to\-day Oracle specialist within a distributed UK/US team, supported by a US\-based integration lead. * You have excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, and are comfortable working with a distributed UK/US team. * Driven by a customer\-obsessed approach, with a passion for automation, reliability and sound cloud governance. * You thrive in a fast and challenging environment without compromising quality or security. * Desire to work as part of a remote, cross\-functional and highly collaborative team \- not ‘just integration’. * Curious mindset and willing to test and learn, to be wrong and to try new things. **What You’ll Do** * Build and maintain Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) integrations \- REST\-based flows, orchestrations and long\-running processes with compensation \- connecting Oracle Fusion ERP to the wider application platform, working to agreed integration designs. * Integrate Oracle Fusion Cloud applications (Financials, SCM, HCM) via REST APIs, and implement bulk and file\-based patterns using FBDI and BI Publisher. * Implement event\-driven flows from Fusion business events through OIC and OCI Streaming into the platform’s Azure integration fabric. * Build version\-controlled deployment pipelines for OIC integration artifacts, automating promotion across environments * Monitor and report OIC capacity and message consumption against the agreed capacity model, flagging headroom risks early. * Provision and operate the OCI platform services that support integration \- identity (IAM), compartments, Object Storage, Streaming, vaults/secrets \- as infrastructure\-as\-code with Terraform via OCI Resource Manager. * Implement observability \- OCI Monitoring and Logging plus integration\-level tracing, and support incident response for integration failures. * Work day\-to\-day with the client’s Oracle ERP partner team within the agreed operating model, raising and tracking change requests, reviewing integration specifications and maintaining joint runbooks. * Automate operational and provisioning tasks with Terraform, Bash and/or Python; document standards and runbooks. * Support hybrid and multi\-cloud interoperability between the OCI and Azure components of the solution, alongside our Azure DevOps engineer. **The Ideal Candidate Will Bring** **Essential skills and experience** * 3–5 years in integration, Oracle development or cloud engineering roles, with demonstrable hands\-on OIC delivery. * Experience integrating Oracle Fusion Cloud applications \- REST APIs and FBDI / BI Publisher patterns. * A good grasp of integration patterns: synchronous REST, event\-driven, and batch/file. * Infrastructure as code with Terraform (OCI Resource Manager or equivalent). * Solid Linux fundamentals and scripting (Bash and/or Python). * Working knowledge of cloud networking, identity and security on OCI. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work across a distributed UK/US team. **Desirable** * OIC or OCI certification \- e.g. OIC Professional, OCI Architect Associate, or OCI Foundations. * BICC (BI Cloud Connector) extract experience. * Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) or Autonomous Data Warehouse exposure. * Oracle Visual Builder (VBCS) experience. * CI/CD pipeline experience (OCI DevOps, Github CI, Azure DevOps or similar). * Experience operating in multi\-cloud setups, especially alongside Microsoft Azure. * Background in field\-service, logistics, dispatch or data\-intensive platforms. **Reporting Line \& Collaboration** This role reports to the Integration Lead (US\-based), who owns the Oracle integration architecture on the account and will agree integration designs with you. You will partner closely with the Azure DevOps engineer to deliver a coherent, well\-integrated platform, and work day\-to\-day with the client’s Oracle ERP partner team, who own and operate parts of the Oracle integration estate. The role will interface with the client’s technical team on the US East Coast and with the CDO (Florida) as the engagement requires, so a working pattern offering daily overlap with both the UK and the US is expected. **Our Values** To deliver exceptional products for exceptional clients, the Dauntless crew are: * Fearless \- we dive in, even into uncharted territory, and our experience enables us to navigate into the unknown. * Curious \- we learn our way past problems, adapting and improving when faced with challenges. * Never settle \- we work to the wonder, to the very best possible. We relentlessly pursue excellence in everything we do. * Always grateful \- we get to do this. We show up ready and feel privileged to help people succeed. * One Crew \- we are greater than the sum of our parts. We have fun, work better and accomplish so much more together. **What’s In It For You?** * An opportunity to help the Engineering crew and build a range of exciting products for high profile clients. * A role with a real purpose that you can be proud of. * A highly flexible work environment \- we are 100% remote. * A hardworking, open, positive and fun work environment. * A competitive salary day rate. We aim to provide an environment for passionate people from different backgrounds to thrive, while bringing a wide range of skills and experiences to everything we do. Dauntless is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We value diversity — in backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability and gender identity. Pay: $97,500\.00 \- $136,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * This role is based on EST timezone. You will need to be available to work according to this timezone. Experience: * Oracle Integration Cloud: 5 years (Required) * Oracle Fusion: 5 years (Preferred) * Oracle Fusion REST API's: 5 years (Preferred) * OIC: 5 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: **About the Company** --------------------- Eagle is on a mission to re\-energize the engineering profession. Every road, water system, and power grid starts at an engineering firm. There are 45,700 of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it. **We partner deeply with engineering firms and build an AI\-native operating system to give engineers superpowers:** getting things done faster and better. Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Thomas Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. *Read more about what we're building at* *eagleeng.com**.* **About the Role** ------------------ As Chief of Staff at Eagle, you'll work with the Founders across building strategic partnerships with great engineering firms, helping those firms grow, and supporting Eagle's operations. You'll be an extension of the Founders, and in some places a replacement. We want you to own workstreams, important conversations, and meaningful decisions, to have a perspective, and to mobilize people to get things done. Part of your time will be onsite at our partner engineering firms driving growth, and part will be building Eagle. In this role, you'll: * **Earn trust onsite:** Be onsite at our partner firms and earn the trust of principals and engineers who've never worked with a tech company. * **Run the partnership cadence:** Work with partner firm leadership on the 90\-day plan, comp plan rollout, and key hires. * **Own relationships with founder\-owners:** Meet founder\-owners of engineering firms and own the relationship from first call to signed partnership. Keep it high touch, and solve for their objectives. * **Help run Eagle:** Support Eagle's operations, including recruiting, logistics, and admin. * **Build the partnership:** Help transform our partner engineering firms, against an industry backdrop that’s barely been touched by AI. * **Grow as we grow:** As we add partner firms, paths include leading new partnerships, operating roles at our partner firms, and senior roles at Eagle. We'll talk openly about where you want to go. There’s likely a lot more, ideally new activities created from opportunities you surface within Eagle or our partner firms. **How your time splits:** about a third building new partnerships, a third running Eagle, and a third onsite with our partner firms. The mix shifts as new partnerships launch. **You Could Be a Great Fit If You:** * **Earn trust** + With owners, founders, and executives + Through excellent communication, nuance, and persuasion + By bringing people along with clarity, empathy, and intention * **Show up** + Get on a plane, then implement the ideas you come up with + Unblock the work by meeting people, understanding them, and getting folks aligned * **Stay curious** + Ask hard questions and listen + Figure out things we (Founders) didn't know before + Learn very fast and lean into new domains * **Find the better path** + Use AI tools every day to work faster and automate systems + If you've built something with AI, we want to see it + Pick the faster, better, more cost\-effective route, whether that's AI, people, or vendors * **Are based in NYC, ideally** + Elsewhere in the US works for the right fit + Travel onsite 6 to 8 days a month, mostly Southern California and New York + Some months run heavier, especially when a new partnership launches **Bonus points for:** having started something of your own, negotiating with or convincing people in high\-stakes settings, or building a tool, dashboard, or automation with AI or low\-code. **How to Apply** ---------------- Apply at **jobs.ashbyhq.com/eagle**. If you've built or written something you're proud of, link it. We review applications on a rolling basis. Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Sohum or Mayank, a second founder conversation, an onsite where you walk us through a short case followed by dinner with the team, and references. We'll tell you where you stand after every step. **Don't check every box? Apply anyway.** We hire for hunger, curiosity, and people\-empathy. **Working @ Eagle** ------------------- **Compensation** $200,000 to $250,000 base salary and equity, depending on experience and scope. We'll walk you through both in detail before any offer. **Benefits** **Health Insurance:** Full healthcare, medical and dental **Retirement:** 401(k) **PTO:** Flexible time off **Travel:** Company\-paid **Office:** HQ in New York City, open to you anytime **From Mayank, Sohum, and Tom** **We're nice! We promise.** We're small, fast, and in\-person in New York. We ask a lot of questions, build each other up as professionals, and focus on delivering great outcomes. Sharing a little about us: Mayank (CEO) is the son of an engineering firm owner in post\-Katrina New Orleans. He studied computer science and Wharton finance at Penn (summa) and was a U.S. Presidential Scholar. He worked on applied AI at Bloomberg and as a PM at Ethic, and built insider\-trading detection for the SEC. Sohum (President) is a technology private equity investor. He studied electrical engineering and Wharton finance in Penn's M\&T program (summa), then was a VP at Long Ridge Equity Partners, a technology and services middle\-market private equity firm. Tom (CTO) is a structural engineer turned software engineer. A Cornell grad and licensed P.E., he started at Arup, where he first built software inside the firm, then spent a decade at Palantir, Pivotal, and Replica deploying software within government agencies and Fortune 500s. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. Eagle is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we'll make it work.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid About Ford and ATP Ford Motor Company has endured and thrived for more than 118 years by reimagining how things are built. Today, Ford is leading a once\-in\-a\-generation transformation in manufacturing — scaling EVs, integrating humanoid robotics, additive manufacturing, AI vision, and digital platforms into one seamless operating system: the Ford Production System (FPS/FPS\+) that operates within the FAST framework. Ford Motor Company is undergoing a historic industrial shift — from building great vehicles to building great systems that scale across them. The Advanced Industrial Technology \& Platforms (AITP) organisation was created to operationalise that shift. Our job is not to deploy isolated tools; it is to build a system that learns from factory truth, transforms it into scalable platforms, and turns those platforms into enterprise business value. Advanced Industrial Technology and Platforms (ATP) is a new, centralised organisation designed to position Ford to lead industrial innovation. This team will accelerate our digital evolution and manufacturing excellence — advancing the modernisation of our Ford Manufacturing operations with cutting\-edge technology. As part of Ford Manufacturing, ATP is designed to integrate directly into our manufacturing sites, partner across teams (GME, safety, etc.) and drive innovation from initial idea to full implementation. ATP is led by Managing Director Yung Fung, reporting to Ford Chief Manufacturing Officer Bryce Currie. This structure includes four vertical business units — focused on specific technology stacks — and four horizontals — shared services designed to ensure scale, deployment, and operational consistency. As part of the AITP organisation, the Sight Vertical is responsible for building an end\-to\-end business around AI/ML anomaly detection products, operating as two product families. Sight.Sense detects anomalies in parametric data: Sense.Machine (MiniTerms) for machine performance anomaly prediction and optimisation; Sense.Tooling (AI ToolSense) for tooling life optimisation; Sense.Energy for optimisation of supplies consumption; Sense.Stamping for stamping process anomaly prediction and surface splits; and Sense.MILO for in\-process test quality anomaly detection. Sight.Vision detects anomalies in image data: Vision.Scout for in\-station visual error proofing across manual and automated processes; Vision.Surface for surface defect detection in components and vehicle bodies through the complete manufacturing process; and Vision.Station for manual process monitoring and anomaly detection covering productivity, quality and ergonomics. The Sight Vertical product portfolio are set to converge on the Sight Anomaly Platform, which builds on Ford's Core Systems layer (Core OS, CoreDS, Core AI and CoreApps/FPS\+). Together they form Ford's scalable platform to deliver, process quality assurance, and zero\-downtime, zero\-defect manufacturing. How the Sight Vertical Works The Sight Vertical operates through value\-focused, cross\-functional product teams across two product families: Sight.Sense and Sight.Vision, each led by a Head of Product Family. Product Managers lead the product problem, desired outcome and priority. Engineers and product designers work with them to discover and deliver effective solutions. Engineering Managers retain people, capacity, technical\-system and engineering\-health accountability. This is a vertical\-level role working across both product families. Priorities are agreed between the two Heads of Product and their Engineering Managers, so that your effort is directed by portfolio value. In addition, ATP Core provides the non\-product engineering expertise the verticals depend on — enterprise standards, architecture, industrial controls, cybersecurity and platform guidance. This role holds a matrix reporting line into ATP Core to ensure alignment with those standards and ready access to that expertise. The Opportunity The Sight product portfolio only creates value when it can be integrated into live manufacturing controls systems safely, to standard, and repeatably. Every Sense and Vision deployment touches PLCs, HMIs, plant\-floor compute, industrial networks and the engineering standards that govern them. We are looking for a Controls Engineer to be the Sight Vertical's industrial controls lead — defining how our products interface with Ford controls systems, ensuring every deployment complies with FAST, OMS, safety and OT cybersecurity requirements, and making global replication a matter of configuration rather than fresh controls engineering at each site. The scope spans both product families and their very different controls demands: paramet e they are committed. **Functional \& Technical Knowledge** ------------------------------------- **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Controls, Automation or Mechatronics Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrable experience. * Typically 8\+ years of hands\-on industrial controls engineering experience in manufacturing, including delivery on capital equipment programmes. * Strong PLC programming and diagnostic capability across at least one major platform (Siemens TIA Portal/S7, Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000, or equivalent), plus HMI and SCADA experience. * Demonstrable hands\-on experience integrating machine vision or camera\-based inspection systems with controls — capture triggers, part\-present and cycle signals, lighting control, reject handling and station interlocks. * Solid grasp of industrial networking and protocols — Profinet, Ethernet/IP, OPC\-UA, Modbus — and of plant network architecture. * Hands\-on experience moving plant\-floor data into applications and platforms using MQTT and structured message formats such as JSON, including configuration of industrial middleware or integration tooling — for example DeviceWise, Node\-RED, Ford crossPLC, HiveMQ or equivalent. * Ability to read, review and approve electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic drawings and control panel designs. * Practical experience of machine build, run\-off, installation and commissioning, including issue resolution under launch pressure. * Demonstrated experience applying, governing or authoring engineering standards and specifications, and handling deviation and waiver decisions. * Working knowledge of OT cybersecurity requirements for plant\-floor compute across both Windows and Linux\-based systems — segregation, hardening, patching and access control. * Strong safety discipline on live manufacturing equipment, including lockout (ECPL), permits, risk assessment and machine safety requirements. * Demonstrable experience mentoring engineers and influencing without authority across engineering, plant, IT and supplier stakeholders. * Willingness and ability to travel internationally to plants, OEMs and equipment run\-off. * Fluent professional English. **Preferred Requirements** * Master's degree in a controls, automation or systems engineering discipline. * Familiarity with Ford controls standards and systems — FAST, OMS, MIDAS, OPIC, OneSpot, GPDS, QWX, WMA, QLS\-CM, M/FIS. * Experience of Virtual Commissioning tooling and practice. * Experience deploying industrial PCs, DXD, edge compute and sensor instrumentation into live production environments. * Experience integrating AI/ML, condition monitoring, gauging or quality systems with controls. * Experience of energy monitoring and reduction initiatives on new and retool programmes. * Additional European language (Spanish or German). **Success in Role** ------------------- * A documented, standard controls interface exists for Sight products and is used across both Sense and Vision deployments. * The volume of site\-specific controls engineering and of deviation and waiver requests falls measurably over time. * New and retooled equipment is specified so that Sight product capability is designed in, reducing retrofit cost and lead time. * Virtual Commissioning is completed for Sight\-related controls software ahead of physical commissioning. * Cybersecurity compliance for all Sight plant\-floor compute is evidenced and current, with no unresolved exceptions. * Controls\-related product launch and downtime issues are resolved quickly and permanently, with root causes eliminated at source. * Controls obsolescence and lifecycle risk is visible, with credible migration plans in place. * Launch and Deployment Engineers and software engineers demonstrably grow in controls capability; critical knowledge is not held by you alone. * Ford standards, procedures and specifications you administer are current, proportionate and genuinely used.

Forsgren, an Apex Company, is seeking a motivated and experienced Structural Bridge Engineer to join our growing Structural Engineering Department in Boise, Idaho. This is an exciting opportunity to work on meaningful infrastructure projects that serve communities throughout Idaho. Our team delivers planning, engineering, and construction management services for transportation, industrial, and environmental projects, with a strong emphasis on local and regional work throughout Idaho. The projects you'll support will primarily be located across Idaho, working with agencies and clients including the Idaho Transportation Department (ITD) and Local Highway Technical Assistance Council (LHTAC). What we're looking for: * Bachelor's in Civil Engineering or related field * Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain within 12 months. * 5\+ years of progressively responsible structural design experience. * Experience in concrete, steel, and/or prestressed concrete bridge design is preferred. * Working knowledge of AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications. * Familiarity with Idaho Transportation Department (ITD) and/or LHTAC standards, specifications, and design practices is preferred. * Experience with structural analysis software such as CSiBridge, SAP2000, LPILE, RISA3D, or similar. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage structural tasks under supervision. * Working knowledge of AutoCAD; experience with MicroStation is a plus. **Why you'll love working for us:** * Company\-subsidized medical and dental. * Company\-paid life, short, and long\-term disability. * 401k match, tuition assistance, and more. * Cross\-training and the ability to work on a variety of projects. * Performance\-based bonuses or other incentives. * Working with the best and brightest in the industry. * 2,000\+ employee national firm with 70\+ locations across the US. You will play a crucial role in fighting fraud, waste, and abuse. **MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:** * Manage and support the AWS cloud infrastructure and enterprise platforms that power the program's data ingestion, analytics, and partner\-facing applications, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Amazon WorkSpaces, and secure file transfer services. * Collaborate with Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Security, and Web Development teams, and with external healthcare partners, to provide infrastructure solutions and secure data exchange. * Drive continuous improvement by remediating vulnerabilities, keeping platforms current, and automating recurring operational work with proven and emerging technologies such as AI, serverless, and IaC. * Utilize hands\-on experience in administering and automating resilient, high\-performing systems. **WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:** * Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. AWS services in production, such as EC2, ECS, S3, Route 53, VPC, IAM, Elastic Load Balancing, RDS, and CloudWatch, following least privilege and cloud security best practices. * Foundational networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, SSH/SFTP, and firewall concepts. * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation or similar automation frameworks. * Experience administering or supporting Linux and Windows operating systems in enterprise or production environments. * Proficiency with scripting and programming languages, including Python, Bash, PowerShell, or other applicable languages. * Experience administering enterprise applications hosted on cloud infrastructure, including upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, and availability management. * Experience administering or supporting Active Directory, including user and group management, group policy, and integration with applications and multi\-factor authentication services. * Experience with vulnerability and patch management, including remediating scanner findings within defined timelines and deploying updates across servers and virtual desktops. * Experience in a 24/7 production environment, including ticket\-based operational support, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and change management. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability upgrades, licensing, and vendor support coordination. * Experience administering Amazon WorkSpaces and endpoint protection tools. * Experience with multi\-account AWS environments, AWS Organizations, service control policies, and centralized governance models. * Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks, including NIST, CIS benchmarks, FedRAMP, or FISMA. * Experience maintaining STIG\-hardened machine images and automated image build pipelines. * Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as AWS Systems Manager, PDQ Deploy, or comparable platforms. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, or equivalent organization\-approved tools for code generation, troubleshooting, and infrastructure automation. jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Georgia Southern University is the state's largest and most comprehensive center of higher learning south of Atlanta, and one of the most dynamic public universities in the Southeast. Founded in 1906, Georgia Southern has grown from a single\-purpose college into a Carnegie Doctoral/R2 institution with 149 degree programs at the bachelor's, master's and doctoral levels, serving 31,600 students from all 50 states, Washington D.C., Puerto Rico and more than 100 nations. Four distinct campuses extend Georgia Southern's reach across the region: a 900\-acre quintessential college campus in Statesboro, anchored by Georgian\-style red\-brick buildings set among oaks and pines; the Armstrong Campus in Savannah, minutes from historic downtown and a short drive from the beaches of Tybee Island; a modern, purpose\-built facility in Hinesville serving local and military\-affiliated students; and the East Georgia Campus in Swainsboro, an outdoor oasis nestled on a 385\-acre pine forest, offering expanded pathways to higher education for students across southeast Georgia. Through ten colleges, the Allen E. Paulson College of Engineering and Computing, the College of Arts and Humanities, the College of Behavioral and Social Sciences, the College of Education, the College of Science and Mathematics, the Jack N. Averitt College of Graduate Studies, the Jiann\-Ping Hsu College of Public Health, the Parker College of Business, the Waters College of Health Professions and University College, Georgia Southern delivers academic programs backed by real\-world experience, research with regional and national impact, and a faculty committed to helping every student go further than they thought possible. Accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges and holding specialized accreditation across its professional programs, Georgia Southern prepares graduates who are ready to lead, contribute and soar beyond, in Georgia, across the nation and around the world. For more information, visit GeorgiaSouthern.edu. **Location** ------------ Remote **Department Information** -------------------------- Enterprise Application Service **Job Summary** --------------- This position works closely with business analysts and functional units to design, develop, document, test, and maintain application programs, systems and interfaces that serve students, faculty, and staff across the University. This role sits at the center of a multi\-year modernization. New services are built in TypeScript on Bun and deployed to Azure Kubernetes Service. At the same time, the University is moving reporting and aggregation off Banner local tables and onto PostgreSQL, retiring a long\-lived PHP application, and migrating HR and financial integrations from PeopleSoft to Workday. The developer in this role contributes to new construction and to the safe retirement of what it replaces. Development on this team is AI\-assisted as a matter of daily practice. The incumbent is expected to use those tools fluently and to verify independently what they produce. Prior experience with Ellucian Banner is not required. Institutional systems knowledge is taught here; modern development practice is what the position is hired for. ***This is a fully remote position. The incumbent must reside and work in the states of Georgia, Florida, or South Carolina.*** **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, build, test and maintain the backend services, integrations and interfaces that connect the University's enterprise systems and move data between them. Systems in scope include the Student Information System (Ellucian Banner), HR and financial platforms, and vendor\-managed applications used across the institution * Analyze functional specifications against actual system behavior, and raise gaps, conflicting requirements and unstated assumptions to business analysts and functional owners before development begins. Consult with business analysts and functional users to clarify work requests, contribute to technical design, and document assigned work * Modernize and retire legacy components, including scheduled batch processes and long\-lived application code, without interrupting the services that depend on them * Work in both Git and Subversion while remaining repositories are migrated to Git, and contribute to that migration * Participate in code review as both author and reviewer, and write changes that a peer or an automated check can evaluate and maintain. Apply the same review and testing standards to AI\-assisted code as to any other change * Produce technical and operational documentation, particularly for vendor\-managed systems whose documented behavior and actual behavior differ * Work in systems outside a primary area of familiarity, including pairing with or shadowing the developer who supports a system, and document and share working knowledge of the systems this position supports, so that no system depen  late\-arriving data. * Experience with Git in a peer\-reviewed development workflow, including branching, pull requests, and automated checks that gate merges * Experience analyzing a written requirement against actual system behavior, and raising gaps, conflicts and unstated assumptions before development begins rather than at delivery **Apply Before Date** --------------------- November 18, 2026 ***Application review may begin as early as October 13, 2026\.*** **Contact Information** ----------------------- For more information or questions about a job posting, please contact the Department of Human Resources by phone at (912\) 478\-6947 or by email at hrservice@georgiasouthern.edu. For technical support, please call the USG Service Desk at (877\) 251\.2644, or email support@usg.edu. **USG Core Values** ------------------- The University System of Georgia is comprised of our 25 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards. More details on the USG Statement of Core Values and Code of Conduct are available in USG Board Policy 8\.2\.18\.1\.2 and can be found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section8/C224/\#p8\.2\.18\_personnel\_conduct. Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6\.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653\. **Conditions of Employment** ---------------------------- Offers of employment are contingent upon completion of background investigation including a criminal background check demonstrating your eligibility for employment with Georgia Southern University, as determined by Georgia Southern University in its sole discretion, confirmation of the credentials and employment history reflected in your application materials and, if applicable, a satisfactory credit check. Applicants may be subject to a pre\-employment drug test. Offers are made expressly subject to the applicable federal and state laws, to the statutes, rules and regulations of this institution and to the Bylaws and Policies of the Board of Regents (BOR) of the University System of Georgia (USG), which are available for your inspection upon request. Legally authorized to work in the United States for the duration of employment without assistance from the University. Must be able to perform duties and responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodation. Georgia Southern University is a Tobacco and Smoke\-Free Community. Internet access. Ability to comply with university document security measures. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Georgia Southern University provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion, age, veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. Individuals in need of reasonable accommodations under the America with Disabilities Act to participate in the search process should notify Human Resources: (912\) 478\-6947\. **Other Information** --------------------- * Must be able to perform duties and responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodation. * Work generally performed in an office environment. * Workweek may occasionally extend beyond 40 hours. * Travel may be required. * Work week may extends to evenings, weekends and/or holidays. * May be required to maneuver items weighing up to 25 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation. * Stand, bend, walk and lift as needed throughout the day. * Must be able to respond by changing their own schedule without prior notice in many cases. **Background Check** -------------------- * Standard \+ Education

jobs.title: Advanced Packaging Development Engineer, Quantum AI
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a specialized field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP, etc.), or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in 3 of the following areas of packaging development: simulation, layout and design, process engineering, assembly, test and measurement, failure analysis. * 5 years of experience with one or more of the following technologies: 2\.5D/3D integration, wafer level packaging, panel level packaging, bump bonding. * 3 years of experience delivering R\&D concepts to a released product. * 3 years of experience developing advanced packaging solutions. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP). * Experience in a semiconductor packaging environment. * Experience using simulation tools to evaluate electrical/RF, thermal, or mechanical performance of packaging structures and guide new designs. * Familiarity with quantum computing hardware architectures and the specific constraints they impose on packaging design. **About the job** ----------------- In the device packaging group, we build custom packaging technologies for quantum processors, amplifiers, and other electronic devices that operate from DC to microwave frequencies in a cryogenic environment. Our work includes research on quantum processor performance and qubit environment, test articles, and hardening of current technologies for deployment. Every Google Quantum AI processor comes through our lab for packaging before its deployment to the fleet. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C\+\+, Java, JavaScript). * 5 years of experience with design and architecture; and testing/launching software products. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role across a large organization. * Experience bringing a new product or significant feature\-set to market. * Experience with streaming media, ideally live\-streamed video at scale. * Experience with building or building on top of AI foundation models. * Strong stakeholder management, alignment, and cross\-company partnership skills, with experience developing joint product and engineering roadmaps cross\-functionally. **About the job** ----------------- Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. As the Engineering Lead, you will serve as the chief technical authority managing the architecture, and cross\-company integration of a new AI\-native product, leading it through the full 0\-to\-1 life\-cycle. You will move from idea explorations to prototyping, cross\-company collaboration and experimentation. You will embrace ambiguity to refine concepts into lovable products. You will translate complex multi\-modal technologies into software, support a core team, and mentor staff leads. Partnering with research and product teams you will deliver a seamless, low\-latency engine for novel applications. You are an expert systems architect with a background in ML and real\-time media, spatial, or XR systems. Labs is a group focused on incubating early\-stage efforts in support of Google’s mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team exists to help discover and create new ways to advance our core products through exploration and the application of new technologies. We work to build new solutions that have the potential to transform how users interact with Google. Our goal is to drive innovation by developing new Google products and capabilities that deliver significant impact over longer timeframes.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: High Speed Circuit Designer, Quantum AI
jobs.description: The application window will be open until at least October 18, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Goleta, CA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience in analog, digital, or mixed\-signal design. * 3 years of experience designing printed circuit boards (PCBs) containing GHz\-rate data converters, field\-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), or processors. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field. * Experience in multiple electrical engineering design disciplines (e.g., FPGA, AMS, or RF at the board and, possibly, chip level), including specification discovery to system deployment. * Experience leading development projects, including successful system deployments. * Experience with vendor management. * Experience with packaging and signal integrity/power integrity (SI/PI) tools. * Understanding of industry board\-level design practices across relevant disciplines (analog/mixed\-Signal (AMS), RF, FPGA, etc.), including relevant design tools. **About the job** ----------------- Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct\-to\-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration. In this role, you will be a key team member in the development of quantum control and measurement systems. You will leverage radio frequency (RF), analog, or mixed\-signal expertise to implement high\-performance board\-level designs which are then used to control our quantum computers. You will work with ASIC designers to architect system\-level solutions which allow us to improve our system density and performance. You will document your designs and measurement results and present these data to relevant stakeholders. You will support team\-members using the equipment you have designed as they integrate it into larger quantum computing systems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large\-scale computer capable of complex, error\-corrected computations. Google Quantum AI's mission is to build this computer and unlock solutions to classically intractable problems. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Support deployment and operations of electronics to Google’s fleet of quantum computers. * Contribute to the design of control and measurement systems for next generation quantum computers, from architecture through implementation and deployment. * Drive board\-level projects of high complexity to completion, collaborating with team of engineers. * Document work and share result with relevant stakeholders. jobs.title: Silicon Validation Engineer, HBM, Google Cloud
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience in bringing up ASICs, performing functional and performance validation, or debugging failures. * Experience scripting in Python or a similar programming language. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture, or a related field. * 2 years of experience with C\+\+/Python software design principles. * Experience bringing up high\-power ASICs and working with memories. * Experience with reading hardware description languages (SystemVerilog) and chip design flow, and building test automation tools and scripts. * Passion for unusual computer architectures. **About the job** ----------------- In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting\-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML\-driven systems. In this role, you will work on test design, bring\-up, triage, and debug of the TPU High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) subsystem across emulation, test chip, and production silicon platforms. You will work closely with Silicon Validation, HBM technologists, and pre\-silicon teams during the development phase of the ASIC life\-cycle, ensuring proper features are in place for post\-silicon validation and debug. Once silicon is in the lab, you will collect and help interpret data alongside system software and software test infrastructure developers to ensure the HBM subsystem has met the threshold for production release. You will help develop processes and tests to ensure smooth and reliable performance of HBM projects. You will be direct throughout the project lifecycle, from early pre\-silicon planning and test development, through end\-of\-life characterization and failure debug. By leveraging silicon knowledge you will develop and operate software\-based tests for full investigation of HBM operation. You will work closely with hardware and software teams to successfully validate designs, identify design issues, and gain insight into the requirements for full ASIC test coverage. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $138000 \- $197000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop detailed silicon test plans, based on design specifications and coordination with a cross\-functional silicon team (architecture, design, software, firmware) for Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). * Implement test plans by developing software tests and flows for system validation and verification, then utilize it all to test hardware, collect data, and characterize the operation of HBMs in both test chips and production silicon. * Triage and debug issues found during new product development and find solutions. jobs.title: Sr Technical Producer
jobs.description: At Wizards of the Coast, we connect people around the world through play and imagination. From our genre\-defining games like Magic: The Gathering® and Dungeons \& Dragons® to our growing multiverse, we continue to innovate and build new ways to foster friendship and connection. That’s where you come in! We have an exciting **Senior Technical Producer** position open within the Magic: The Gathering Arena production team. In this role, you will handle a developer squad responsible for building the internal systems that keep Arena operating without issues. The ideal candidate brings years of experience working with technical teams and meeting feature and service update schedules defined by the organization and the team. What You'll Do * Work within an Agile framework and advocate for its guidelines. * Communicate through roadmaps, reports, and documentation, outlining 2\-3 year plans for upper management, and keeping your team informed of what’s next. * Own Agile ceremonies, confidently remove team obstacles, acquire necessary resources, and push back appropriately when required. * Mentor mid\- and associate\-level production staff, sharing knowledge and teaching methodologies. * Maintain relationships with internal and external partners, reviewing and commenting on technical whitepapers and contracts. * Raise red flags at the right time and involve the right resources to effect immediate, proactive change. * Conduct RCAs as needed and coordinate a weekly sync with all live service\-associated engineers on Arena. * Lead direct reports across production fields. What You'll Bring The successful candidate will have a strong mix of technical experience and live service delivery in the gaming space. Arena's updates span multiple platforms and locales, and this team is crucial to keeping everything running efficiently. * A career grounded in a technical background, whether as an engineer, through personal projects, or on teams primarily composed of software engineers. * Ability to articulate Agile methodologies, what changes you’ve implemented, and why. * Skill in analyzing work, balancing competing priorities to protect the team’s focus. * Capability to lead your squad’s initiatives from start to finish with minimal input from management. * Outstanding communication skills and a servant\-leader approach. * Passion for continuous improvement, with the ability to identify and implement necessary changes. * Experience with enterprise project management tools (Jira, Rally, Basecamp, Trello, Project, Smartsheet, Asana, etc.). * Clear written and verbal communication skills, translating complex plans into high\-level summaries for non\-technical audiences. * Experience managing a team of junior producers. Demonstrate mentorship to reports and peers. Nice to Have * Scrum, PO, or SAFe (SP/SHWA/SSM) certification. * Previous experience in engineering, scripting, automation, and/or technical writing. * Familiarity with Cloud Architecture (Azure, AWS, GCP), Containerization/Orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), Telemetry stacks (Grafana, Datadog), Build systems (Python, Jenkins), and Alerting systems (Opsgenie, Xmatters). * Comfort working with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, operations, marketing, and external vendors. * A passion for Magic: The Gathering and familiarity with its community; knowledge of Arena as a product is a plus. * Example of managing at least one direct report to promotion. **We are an Equal Opportunity Employer** Wizards of the Coast is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment. We are committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you have a disability and require assistance in this application process and need to request an accommodation, please contact your recruiter or coordinator. The base salary range for this position is $126,600\.00 to $230,500\.00\. The hiring range will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location and market conditions. Additionally, employees may be eligible for annual and long\-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package. Our Comprehensive Benefits Package Includes: * Health \& Wellness: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Time Off to Recharge: Paid Vacation \& Holidays * Financial Well\-being: Generous 401(k) Match * Life \& Family Support: Paid Parental Leave * Giving Back: Volunteer \& Employee Giving Programs * Level Up Your Skills: Tuition Reimbursement * Exclusive Perks: Product Discounts \& More! \#Wizards

professional setting. * Advanced proficiency in front\-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Vue.js). * Advanced knowledge of back\-end technologies (Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java, etc.). * problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. * Ability to travel and work events around the country/world. **What We’re Looking For** We're looking for curious, collaborative, and solution\-oriented developers who enjoy building impactful technology and tackling complex challenges.
