jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY** New\-Indy Containerboard (NICB) is seeking an ITOT Sr. System Engineer, with a keen focus on optimization, reliability and performance of all cloud and on\-premises IT server infrastructure, being responsible for the overall day\-to\-day management and support of the enterprise infrastructure and computing technologies deployed at all NICB locations. The right candidate for this position can leverage technology to ensure operational excellence of IT Server systems within the 24/7/365 manufacturing facilities across North America. The ITOT Sr. Systems Engineer will serve as an escalation point of contact within the Systems Administration team for all activities related to the broad range of tools and technologies deployed involving servers, virtualization (both on\-premise and cloud), storage, backups, as well as Office365 and Domain Administration tasks. To ensure success, the ideal candidate should have in\-depth knowledge of IT infrastructure platforms and tools relevant to systems administration, such as VMWare, Microsoft O365 and Active Directory, overall manufacturing technology sectors, and is driven to understand all aspects of NICB’s business, in assuring the effectiveness of the IT infrastructure Systems solutions deployed, and in collaborating to the continuous improvement of NICB’s Enterprise IT \& OT organization going\-forward. **RESPONSIBILTIES** High\-level Day to Day Problem Resolution: * Leverage your technical skills to resolve tickets and problems escalated related to IT Infrastructure Systems. * Determine the root cause of problems and eliminate those barriers to success. * Work with Systems Administration team members to ensure proper training and establish a strong foundation for communication and collaborative teamwork. High\-level Strategy \& Planning * Design, implement and maintain the organization's server infrastructure, including on\-premises and cloud\-based solutions. * Manage the integration of cloud\-based solutions with on\-premises infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security. * Work with external vendors and service providers as needed. Governance \& Planning * Take a lead technical role within the Systems Administration team to ensure all systems infrastructure and services are maintained in a multi\-site 24/7 environment across North America. * Collaborate with NICB’s Enterprise IT \& OT teams, to assess near\- and long\-term infrastructure capacity needs in support of IT Leadership directives. * Create and maintain documentation as it relates to infrastructure configuration, processes, and service records. * Assist in the development and adoption of policies, procedures, and associated training plans for overall infrastructure administration, usage, and disaster recovery. Acquisition \& Deployment * Deploy and take part in the design of enterprise infrastructure technologies including servers, storage and backups, UPSs, and coordinate with site maintenance personnel to ensure the reliability of datacenter\\computer rooms supporting plant operations. * Assist with architecting enterprise level redundant server infrastructure with an understanding of the Perdue model for manufacturing networks. * Conduct research on infrastructure products, services, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the infrastructure industry. * Oversee new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades of IT Systems. * Take part in deployments and maintenance of new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades of network devices. Operational Management * Configure systems infrastructure to ensure their smooth and reliable operation for fulfilling business objectives and processes. * Monitor systems infrastructure performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed. * Responsible for the day\-to\-day maintenance of servers, including database, print, and backup servers and their associated operating systems and software. * Responsible for the day\-to\-day maintenance of Group Policies, performing best practice management of Active Directory and O365\. * Coordinate and execute patching of all systems equipment as available patching windows and as guided by the NICB Enterprise Security team. * Practice asset management, including maintenance of server component inventory and related documentation and technical specifications information. * Monitor and test systems performance and provide information for relevant KPIs. * Participate in managing all infrastructure security solutions. * Perform server and security audits, and system backups and recovery. * Adherence to change control processes. **SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** * Associate’s degree in business, IT or similar discipline, or commensurate equivalent work experience in a technology field. * Organizational skills, attention to detail, follow up, documentation preparation and maintenance skills, and customer service orientation are crucial for success in this role. * Exceptional interpersonal skills, with a focus on rapport\-building, listening, and questioning. * Exceptional written and oral communication skills. * Experience within or support of 24x7 manufacturing environments. * Extensive application support experience with MS Office. * Familiarity with the fundamental principles of ITIL, especially change management and MOC processes. * 10\+ years’ direct and advanced experience in administering enterprise\-level IT infrastructure solutions. * Proven experience in maintaining enterprise level infrastructure systems and related solutions. * Advance experience with maintaining Microsoft server operational systems and virtualization platforms (VMWare). * Advanced knowledge of computer hardware, networking and system administration. * Extensive experience with Server Hardware (HPE, Dell), along with iSCSI storage (Nimble, EMC\\Dell PowerStore and\\or PowerMax). * Knowledge of Hyperconverged Infrastructure (VXRail, SimpliVity) * Knowledge of 1, 10, 25, 40 and 100Gbps Ethernet required. * Experience with server backups * Ability to conduct research into a wide range of computing issues as required. * jobs.description: **Job Title** Automation Design Engineer – Automotive Welding **Job Summary** You will design, develop, and test automated welding systems and robotic tooling for automotive manufacturing. Your work includes creating 3D models, selecting automation equipment, and ensuring designs meet safety and customer standards. **Key Responsibilities** * **Design Systems:** Create 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings for robotic welding cells, end\-of\-arm tooling, and assembly fixtures using CAD software like SolidWorks or AutoCAD. * **Integrate Robotics:** Select and integrate industrial robots, welding guns (MIG, TIG, Resistance/Spot), sensors, and safety hardware. * **Collaborate:** Work with project managers, controls engineers, and the shop floor to ensure designs are practical and buildable. * **Review Safety:** Ensure all mechanical and automation designs follow OSHA, RIA, and customer\-specific safety standards. * **Support Build \& Launch:** Assist with assembly troubleshooting, robot path simulations, and final buy\-off at customer sites if needed. **Qualifications \& Skills** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). * **Experience:** 3 to 5 years of experience in automation design, specifically within the automotive or tier\-1 welding supplier industry. * **Software Skills:** Proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, CATIA, or Inventor) and robotic simulation tools (Robcad or Process Simulate). * **Knowledge Base:** Strong understanding of resistance spot welding, MIG welding, pneumatic components, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T). **Job Title:** Process Automation Design Engineer – Automotive Welding Systems **Department:** Process Engineering / Automation **Reports To:** Engineering Manager **Position Summary:** The Process Automation Design Engineer is responsible for designing, simulating, and optimizing complete automated welding manufacturing lines. This role focuses on the macro\-level process layout, material flow, cycle\-time (thru\-put) analysis, and the high\-level integration of FANUC robotic arms into coherent production cells. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Process \& Layout Design:** Develop 2D/3D manufacturing line layouts, sequence of operations, and process flow diagrams for robotic MIG, spot, and laser welding cells. * **FANUC Robot Simulation:** Utilize simulation software (such as FANUC ROBOGUIDE or Process Simulate) to perform reach studies, interference checks, and cycle time analysis. * **System Integration:** Define the interaction between FANUC robots, material handling systems, safety gating, and PLC\-controlled equipment. * **Cycle Time Optimization:** Analyze and optimize robot paths and process steps to meet strict automotive customer throughput requirements. * **Specifications \& Standards:** Ensure all process designs comply with automotive OEM specifications (e.g., Ford, GM, Stellantis) and safety standards (RIA/OSHA). * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Tooling Design Engineers to align fixture placement with robot access paths and process constraints. **Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Automation Engineering. * **Experience:** 3\+ years in automotive process automation design, focusing on robotic welding lines. * **Technical Skills:** High proficiency in FANUC ROBOGUIDE, AutoCAD, and 3D CAD platforms. Deep knowledge of MIG/MAG and resistance spot welding parameters. * **Knowledge:** Strong understanding of automotive assembly line routing, safety circuits, and line balancing. **Job Title:** Tooling Automation Design Engineer – Welding \& FANUC **Department:** Mechanical Design / Tooling **Reports To:** Tooling Engineering Supervisor **Position Summary:** The Tooling Automation Design Engineer is responsible for the mechanical design of welding fixtures, clamping systems, and specialized End\-of\-Arm Tooling (EOAT) for FANUC robots. This role ensures parts are held precisely to meet tight tolerances during high\-stress robotic welding applications. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Fixture \& Tooling Design:** Design 3D geometric welding fixtures, manual/pneumatic clamping systems, and heavy\-duty robotic EOAT using SolidWorks, CATIA, or NX. * **FANUC Payload \& Center of Gravity (CG) Analysis:** Calculate load capacities, moments of inertia, and CG for EOAT to ensure compliance with specific FANUC robot payload profiles. * **Component Selection:** Specify standard automation components including pneumatic cylinders, toggle clamps, proximity sensors, grippers, and slide units. * **GD\&T Application:** Apply strict Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) to fabrication prints to ensure part repeatability and quality. * **Welding Environment Design:** Material selection and shielding design to withstand weld spatter, high heat, and harsh production environments. * **Build Support:** Support the toolroom build, assembly, shim\-tuning, and try\-out phases of fixtures and EOAT. **Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Tool \& Die Design, or equivalent trade experience. * **Experience:** 3\+ years designing physical tooling, fixtures, and robotic grippers for automotive body\-in\-white (BIW) welding applications. * **Technical Skills:** Advanced 3D CAD modeling skills (SolidWorks preferred); strong knowledge of pneumatics and fluid power schematics. * **Knowledge:** Deep understanding of FANUC robot mechanical mounting interfaces and payload constraints.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: The Network Engineer provides advanced technical support for network operations and serves as a technical link among the NOC, Sales Engineering, Sales, customers, carriers, and vendors. The position resolves escalated network issues, supports network changes and service implementations, and assists with the development of customer solutions. The role combines hands\-on troubleshooting, network engineering support, implementation planning, technical documentation, process improvement, and customer\-facing technical support. RESPONSIBILITIES * Provide Tier 2 troubleshooting and escalation support for network, Internet, transport, circuit, and customer connectivity issues. * Diagnose routing, switching, VLAN, QoS, bandwidth, and connectivity problems using network configurations, logs, alerts, interface statistics, and performance data. * Troubleshoot BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD\-WAN, Ethernet, Internet, VPN, and carrier transport services. * Guide NOC staff during complex or service\-impacting incidents and coordinate escalations with carriers, vendors, and engineering resources. * Support planned network maintenance, upgrades, migrations, customer cutovers, and configuration changes, including post\-change validation. * Assist with router, switch, firewall, SD\-WAN, monitoring, and network\-service configurations and deployments. * Support implementation planning, testing, proof\-of\-concept activities, and evaluations of new network technologies. * Participate in customer discovery to understand network, bandwidth, resiliency, connectivity, and technical requirements. * Review proposed solutions for feasibility, supportability, risks, dependencies, equipment needs, and alignment with network capabilities. * Provide technical input for network designs, proposals, statements of work, bills of materials, quotes, and implementation plans. * Support customer\-facing technical discussions and coordinate the handoff of approved services into implementation and ongoing operations. * Maintain network diagrams, configurations, circuit information, troubleshooting guides, implementation records, and technical standards. * Identify opportunities to improve or automate network operations, monitoring, implementation, documentation, and service\-delivery processes. * Participate in post\-incident reviews and document root causes, corrective actions, and recommended improvements. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE * Three to five or more years of experience in network operations, network engineering, telecommunications, managed services, or a similar technical environment. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex production network and customer connectivity issues. * Experience supporting customer\-facing network services and working with telecommunications carriers or service providers. * Ability to read and understand network diagrams and router and switch configurations. * Strong technical documentation and communication skills. * Experience supporting customer solution design or Sales Engineering activities is preferred. * Cisco, networking, or equivalent industry certifications are beneficial but not required. TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE * TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing, subnetting, routing, and switching. * BGP, OSPF, VLANs, Ethernet, MPLS, and SD\-WAN. * QoS, bandwidth management, VPNs, redundancy, and failover. * Firewalls, carrier circuits, Internet services, and basic network\-security concepts. * Network monitoring and management systems, including Syslog, SNMP, and performance monitoring. Experience with Cisco, Meraki, Versa, LogicMonitor, or similar platforms is beneficial. COMPETENCIES SKILLS AND ABILITIES * Strong technical troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently on escalated network issues. * Understanding of both operational support and network design considerations. * Ability to translate customer requirements into practical, supportable technical solutions. * Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong documentation, organization, and process\-improvement skills. * Ability to coordinate effectively across Sales, Engineering, the NOC, vendors, carriers, and customers. * Interest in improving operations through standardization, automation, AI, and better technical tools. Pay: $66,000\.00 \- $82,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Security Engineer - AppSec
jobs.description: **About the Company** --------------------- Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross\-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world. You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1\.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk. **Our Ethos** ------------- We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company. **About the Team** ------------------ Security Engineering is a small team that answers one question: was it built right? We run our own AI\-driven red team against Rain's code and cloud, gate pull requests before they merge, and write the baselines that say how every system should be configured. Our blockchain work is covered. This role owns everything else: the backend services, APIs, cloud, and edge that move real money for real customers. We work closely with Security Operations: we give them high\-quality findings to coordinate fixes for, and clear configuration rules they can build detections on. **About the Team** ------------------ Security Engineering makes sure Rain is built right. We run our own AI\-driven red team against our code and cloud, gate pull requests before they merge, and set the baselines for how every system is configured. This role owns everything outside blockchain: the backend services, APIs, cloud, and edge that move real money. We give Security Operations high\-quality findings to coordinate fixes for, and clear configuration rules to build detections on. **About the Role** ------------------ You'll be Rain's application security expert and the quality bar for every non\-chain finding we produce. The calls are yours: what's real, how bad it is, and what has to be fixed before launch. You'll hold the line with engineers when it matters, and make the case so they agree, not just comply. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Review red team findings before they reach engineers: reproduce them, cut false positives, set severity, and write tickets clear enough to fix without a meeting. Improve the scoring that grades them * Harden our backend services and APIs, especially the money\-moving paths. You'll often write the fix yourself * Own edge defenses: DDoS protection, rate limiting, WAF rules, and abuse controls * Write secure configuration baselines for our cloud, code, and SaaS, and turn them into automated checks * Grow our PR security gate so more bugs are blocked before merge * Own attack surface coverage, and run architecture reviews on new and high\-risk systems * Find, test, and pick the best security tools, whether we buy, adopt, or build **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years in application security, product security, or security\-minded backend engineering * You've owned security decisions. You can tell a senior engineer their design needs to change and keep a good working relationship * You can read an unfamiliar codebase (TypeScript/Node.js) and find the bug that matters, and you know a scary\-sounding finding from a real one * Hands\-on cloud security (ideally GCP), Terraform, and edge defenses like WAFs and rate limiting * Experience with threat models or architecture reviews. You've run tool bake\-offs and dropped tools that didn't earn their cost * You'd rather ship a check than write a document, and you use AI tools heavily without trusting them blindly **Bonus Attributes** -------------------- * Fintech, payments, or card issuing background (PCI DSS a plus) * Pentest, bug bounty, or red team experience * Experience building security scanners, static analysis rules, or LLM\-based review tools * If you have the background: AI security for our agents and agentic payments, or corporate security alongside IT **Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:** -------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Unlimited time off** Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves. **Flexible working** We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace. **Easy to access benefits** For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company\-subsidized life insurance plan. **Retirement goals** Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match. **Equity plan** Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success. **Health and Wellness** High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture \- whatever recharges you! **In\-office meals** Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit. **Team summits** Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international. Compensation Range: $190K \- $240K

jobs.title: Senior Application Support Engineer
jobs.description: Take your career to the next level! In the last few years our goal has been expansion, creating growth opportunities for many of our team members. Not only are we serious about growth, but we are also serious about helping our customers during hard financial times. We take pride in providing solutions and offering a helping hand, not only to our customers but also to the communities we serve. As we continue to expand and grow into a national leader in consumer financing, we invite you to consider joining our team. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and bringing a personal touch to finance, we'd love to have you on board! **Job purpose** The Senior Application Support Engineer serves as a senior technical resource for the support, reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of critical business applications. This role provides advanced Level 2 and Level 3 support, leads complex incident and problem investigations, partners with business, development, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams, and mentors other support engineers. The incumbent helps ensure application services meet availability, service\-level compliance, and operational objectives. **Duties and responsibilities** * Serve as the senior escalation point for complex Level 2 and Level 3 application incidents, owning investigation through restoration, root\-cause identification, and documented resolution. * Assess business impact, establish priority, coordinate technical resources, and provide timely, audience\-appropriate communications during major incidents. * Lead problem management for recurring issues by performing trend analysis, identifying root causes, and driving permanent corrective and preventive actions. * Partner directly with Level One Business Support teams and coach engineers on troubleshooting methods, escalation practices, and customer service. * Collaborate across application development, infrastructure, database, network, security, and vendor teams to resolve cross\-platform and cross\-product issues. * Act as a subject matter expert for assigned applications, including architecture, integrations, dependencies, data flows, configurations, operational risks, and business processes. * Monitor application health, availability, capacity, logs, interfaces, batch processes, and performance; improve alerts, dashboards, and operational thresholds to detect issues proactively. * Own and improve scheduled operational processes, support procedures, runbooks, knowledge articles, system diagrams, and recovery documentation. * Plan and support application releases, configuration changes, patches, upgrades, and deployments across test and production environments, including validation and post\-implementation review. * Ensure adherence to established Release, Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration, Access, and Service Management processes and controls. * Review proposed solutions, technical designs, scripts, code, and deployment plans for supportability, reliability, maintainability, and operational risk. * Develop or enhance scripts, queries, utilities, and automation that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and accelerate diagnosis and recovery. * Participate in software testing through test planning, review, analysis, execution support, defect triage, production\-readiness assessment, and release certification. * Track service\-level performance, support volumes, recurring defects, and operational risks; recommend and lead measurable service improvements. * Provide technical support and operational guidance to projects, ensuring new or changed services transition effectively into production support. * Participate in an on\-call support rotation and coordinate after\-hours response for business\-critical production incidents as required. * Lead technical discussions, triage sessions, knowledge\-sharing activities, and post\-incident reviews; mentor less experienced team members. * Perform other duties as assigned by Leadership. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * Five or more years of progressive experience supporting enterprise or production applications, including advanced Level 2 or Level 3 troubleshooting. * Demonstrated experience leading complex incident resolution and performing root\-cause analysis, problem management, and corrective\-action follow\-through. * Experience using an IT service management platform and working within structured Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Configuration Management processes. * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft development technologies, including .NET, C\#, and Visual Basic, with the ability to review and troubleshoot application code. * Advanced Microsoft SQL Server skills, including complex querying, stored procedure analysis, data validation, and performance troubleshooting. * Experience supporting integrations, APIs, scheduled jobs, services, and multi\-tier applications across test and production environments. * Proficiency with application monitoring, logging, alerting, and diagnostic tools. * Proficient understanding of source control and software delivery tools such as Git and Bitbucket. * Ability to create clear technical documentation, runbooks, support procedures, incident communications, and executive\-ready summaries. * Strong customer orientation and the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business users, vendors, and leadership. * Demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues, lead technical work, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment during high\-impact incidents. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel. * Must pass drug screen and other pre\-employment screenings. **Preferred Qualifications** * Graduate degree or relevant technical certifications, such as Microsoft, database, cloud, or Agile credentials. * Experience supporting applications in the consumer finance or broader financial services industry. * Experience supporting loan management systems and related business processes. * Experience with cloud\-hosted applications, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, or operational automation. * Experience with high availability, disaster recovery, application security controls, audit evidence, and regulated operating environments. * Experience developing service metrics, dashboards, or continuous improvement plans. **Critical Competencies** * Advanced analytical, diagnostic, and problem\-solving skills. * Technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge\-sharing capability. * Ownership, accountability, sound judgment, and composure during critical incidents. * Clear written and verbal communication tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Strong collaboration across business, technology, security, infrastructure, and vendor teams. * Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment, organize work independently, and manage multiple priorities. * Continuous\-improvement mindset with attention to service quality, operational risk, documentation, and sustainable solutions. **Working conditions** This position primarily works in an office environment, sitting at a desk, working on a computer. jobs.title: Sr Staff Digital Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** Renesas is a global semiconductor company providing hardware and software solutions for various cutting\-edge technologies including self\-driving cars, robots, automated factory equipment, and smart home applications. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. Renesas is a global, multi\-billion dollar, a publicly traded company headquartered in Japan, and has subsidiaries in 20 countries worldwide. Renesas is a dynamic, multicultural technology company where employees learn, mentor, innovate and thrive. Renesas is extending our share in fast\-growing data economy\-related markets such as infrastructure and data centers and strengthening our presence in the industrial/IoT and automotive segments. Our solutions drive products developed by major innovators around the world. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics. At Renesas, you will be part of a global engineering organization that values technical excellence, innovation, and collaboration. We offer opportunities to work on complex mixed\-signal and digital SoC products with teams distributed across the United States and Asia, contributing to cutting\-edge semiconductor solutions from concept to production. We are seeking an experienced Sr Staff Digital Design Engineer to join the Analog \& Connectivity Business Group. In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, integration, and implementation of advanced digital and mixed\-signal ICs and SoCs. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in digital design methodologies, RTL development, SoC integration, and design signoff, with a proven track record of delivering successful silicon products. You will work closely with architecture, verification, DFT, physical design, firmware, and analog design teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from specification and architecture definition through silicon validation and production release. Responsibilities * Define digital architecture and micro\-architecture for complex mixed\-signal and SoC products. * Develop high\-quality RTL using Verilog/SystemVerilog and participate in design reviews. * Drive SoC and subsystem integration, including internal bus architectures and peripheral interfaces. * Develop and validate timing constraints, synthesis scripts, and implementation flows. * Analyze and resolve CDC, RDC, Lint, and timing issues to achieve design signoff. * Collaborate with verification teams on test planning, coverage closure, and debugging. * Support DFT implementation including scan, MBIST, JTAG, and production test methodologies. * Work with physical design teams to achieve power, performance, and area goals. * Perform silicon bring\-up, debug, characterization, and root\-cause analysis of silicon issues. * Create and maintain design documentation throughout the development cycle. * Contribute to technology and architecture definition for future product generations. **Qualifications*** MSEE or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with 8\+ years of relevant industry experience, or BSEE with 12\+ years of relevant industry experience. * Strong background in digital IC and SoC architecture, design, and implementation. * Proven experience with SoC interconnects and protocols including AHB, APB, AXI, USB, I2C/I3C, SPI, and UART. * Strong knowledge of embedded memory architectures including SRAM, OTP, MTP, and Flash. * Extensive hands\-on experience with RTL design using Verilog/SystemVerilog. * Experience with the complete ASIC/SoC development flow, including: * RTL design and simulation * SoC integration * Lint and design quality checks * CDC and RDC verification * Logic synthesis * DFT implementation * SDC constraint development * Static Timing Analysis (STA) * Timing closure and design signoff * Strong understanding of multi\-clock designs, reset architecture, and low\-power design methodologies. * Experience driving technical debug and resolution of functional, timing, and silicon issues. * Strong communication, problem\-solving, and teamwork skills. * Highly motivated self\-starter with a passion for technical innovation. * AI savvy and able to leverage AI tools to improve engineering productivity and design quality. Preferred * Mixed\-signal IC development experience and understanding of analog/digital integration challenges. * Experience with industry\-standard EDA tools such as Synopsys Design Compiler, PrimeTime, SpyGlass, VC Static, Verdi, and Cadence design environments. * Hands\-on experience integrating and debugging Arm® processor subsystems (Cortex\-M0, Cortex\-M0\+, Cortex\-M3, Cortex\-M33, or similar Arm cores), including AHB/APB interconnects, memory subsystems, interrupt controllers, debug infrastructure, boot flows, and firmware interaction. * Experience with high\-speed interface design and implementation. * Familiarity with FPGA prototyping and emulation flows. * Mandarin language proficiency is a plus due to collaboration with engineering teams in China. **Additional Information** Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us? Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity \& Inclusion Statement. Renesas Electronics deals with dual\-use technology that is subject to U.S. export controls regulations. Under these regulations it may be necessary for Renesas to obtain U.S. government export license prior to release of technology to certain persons. The decision whether or not to file or pursue an export license application is at the sole discretion of Renesas.

jobs.title: Senior Structural Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: At SSOE, you will engage with an innovation\-driven culture where integrated delivery across architectural, structural, MEP, process, civil, and automation disciplines fuels impactful industrial and complex commercial projects worldwide. Our senior engineers thrive within a mentorship\-rich environment fostering continuous learning, technical excellence, and cross\-discipline collaboration. We prioritize delivering the highest quality engineering products underpinned by well\-defined processes and technology investments, including advanced BIM and AI tools. Career advancement paths are clearly defined, enabling you to grow your technical and leadership capabilities while contributing to projects that shape critical infrastructure. SSOE’s commitment to social responsibility, safety, and integrity ensures your work promotes sustainable, safe, and resilient built environments. AI and Innovation: At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. Responsibilities: The following duties are typical of the position but are not all encompassing. Responsibilities include those required to deliver quality service on schedule and within budget in a team environment.* Applies intensive and diversified knowledge of engineering principles and practices in broad areas of assignments. * Makes decisive, independent decisions on engineering problems, practices, and methods, creating and refining innovative design solutions. In the case of a licensed staff member, acting as a lead project engineer, this includes but is not limited to, the stamping/sealing of one's drawings/documents as well as drawings/documents done as the professional in "responsible charge" as defined by the applicable statute of jurisdiction. * Represents the firm in meetings and conferences to resolve important questions and to plan and coordinate a project. * Plans, develops, coordinates, and directs a medium to large engineering project or a number of smaller complex projects with overall responsibility for budget adherence, schedule adherence, quality control, and inter\-discipline coordination. * Responsible for acceptance or rejection of major items involving materials, equipment, manufacturer's quality, and field construction. * Serve as a key staff advisor and technical specialist in your chosen discipline, leveraging highly specialized knowledge and cutting\-edge techniques to drive project success. * Provide strategic leadership by guiding teams through critical objectives, innovative concepts, policy challenges, and complex project developments. * Supervise, coordinate, and review the work of a team of engineers and designers working on the same assigned project. * Defines project scope of work and organizes into manageable tasks. * Provides supervisor and project manager with scope of work change warnings. * Maintains continuing professional education in discipline. Mentor junior engineers and technicians, providing technical guidance in structural engineering principles, software use, and code application. * Drive business growth through strategic client engagement and proactive business development initiatives. * Meets with client to define project scope, present project progress, and assure client satisfaction * Support risk management initiatives by identifying potential design vulnerabilities related to seismic performance, load path continuity, and material durability per local and national code provisions. * Travel required. * Valid driver's license required. May be waived for international assignments. **What We Offer:** * **Competitive Salary**: $115,000 \- $140,000/year depending on location, education, experience, and certifications. * **Bonus and Incentives:** Based on experience, you will be eligible for our annual target bonus/incentive program derived from company and individual performance and goals. * **Ownership Opportunities**: SSOE offers ownership opportunities to all employees at the Associate level and above. This position will provide you with the opportunity to become a shareholder of SSOE. As an employee\-owned firm, being a shareholder provides an additional level of earnings and investment to our group of owners. * **Comprehensive Benefits**: Health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), professional development and training, generous PTO, and paid holidays. **Additional Perks:** * **Dynamic Culture**: Experience a supportive culture where you're an essential and highly valued member of our vibrant team. * **Exciting Projects**: Work on thrilling projects from inception to completion and engage directly with some of the most innovative clients globally. * **Continuous Learning**: Embrace a culture of perpetual learning where curiosity is celebrated, innovative ideas are welcomed, and your career growth aspirations are fully supported. * **Career Stability**: A diversity of market sectors, project types, and geographic locations that help insulate your career from economic ups and downs. * **Career Advancement**: Embark on a structured career journey with abundant opportunities for growth and advancement. * **Holistic Compensation**: A holistic approach to compensation and benefits that supports your physical and mental health, encourages work\-life balance, and empowers your career advancement and financial success. **SSOE – The Best of Both Worlds** At SSOE, our growth trajectory allows us to offer the opportunities normally associated with a large firm while embracing the collaborative and supportive culture often found in smaller firms. As a member of the SSOE team, you will work on exciting and diverse projects for Fortune 100 clients around the globe, supported by the best technology for the task at hand. You will experience our employee\-centric culture that strives to offer a healthy balance, flexible working arrangements, direct access to leadership at all levels, and a mindset of continuous learning. Once you experience the SSOE difference, you’ll understand the why behind our metrics: * **28%** \- of our employees have been with SSOE for 10 years or more. * **15%** \- percentage of employees with tenure exceeding 15 years. * **99%** \- our CEO’s approval rating on Glassdoor. * **98%** \- portion of our clients who say they would recommend us to a colleague. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in **Civil or Structural Engineering**, which qualifies for licensure in the state of practice, is required. * PE required or SE licensed with eight (8\) or more years of related practical experience with former employer(s). * Working knowledge of BIM collaboration and review platforms including ACC/BIM360, Bluebeam, and Navisworks. * Thorough understanding of US building codes and standards applicable to seismic and structural design: ASCE, ACI, AISC 341, IBC, and applicable state\-specific amendments. * Proven ability to interpret and apply seismic detailing and design requirements for concrete, steel, and foundation systems in seismic design categories D\-F is preferred * Strong client\-facing communication skills with experience leading technical discussions with architects, contractors, and owners. * Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-discipline coordination, review processes, and change control in complex projects. * Experience on **Industrial and Manufacturing** building projects is mandatory. * Experience on **Data Center and/or Pharmaceutical** projects is preferred.

jobs.title: Power Systems Software Engineer - Optimization
jobs.description: **Who are we?** Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale. By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step. Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy. Join our team, get inspired, and help us re\-imagine the world! **Transform the everyday with us!** **We are searching for a Software Engineer for Power Systems** to join our team! As a Software Engineer with Siemens Grid Software, you will join the team that maintains and enhances our industry\-leading power systems simulation product: PSS®E. You will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing the PSS® software platform along with other product team members. This position requires detailed knowledge of software engineering practices, agile development methodologies, a love for computer programming, and the drive to build good test plans, test implementation, and software delivery. Additionally, familiarity with optimization algorithms or electric power systems will set you apart from other candidates. Likewise, since much of what we do involves simulation and data analysis, knowledge and experience of data science, mathematical computation, and optimization techniques will make you stand out. **Based in the New York Capital Region, this position reports into our Schenectady office for in\-person collaboration.** **You’ll make an impact as you:** * Create mathematical algorithms for power systems simulation. This includes creating and maintaining algorithms for power system simulation and optimization * Work with the Grid Simulation software development team on designing, developing, and testing and documenting the software using modern methodologies and tools such as the Scaled Agile Framework, Jira, Confluence, and Git * Implementation will predominately be done in C, C\+\+ and Fortran, applying knowledge of object\-oriented programming, functional programming, and other techniques to accelerate the process of modeling power systems simulations * Create robust tests to assess performance, correctness, and usability of the software * Provide estimates and analysis of tasks required for development * Stay abreast of new developments in power system analysis, modeling, and optimization **You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:** **Basic qualifications:** * Education requirement: Bachelor of Science or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Physics, or similar field with knowledge of mathematical optimization and software engineering * Proven strong abilities in software development and a love for making robust code * Experience developing in Fortran, C, or C\+\+ required; Python is a strong plus, as our codebase spans multiple languages * Candidates must meet one of the following experience pathways: + Bachelor’s degree with 2\+ years of professional software development experience + Graduate degree with hands\-on academic coding experience + Completion of a Siemens software development internship * Ability to travel up to 10% * Experience developing on the Microsoft Windows operating system * Familiarity with automated software build processes and environments * Experience using Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code * Experience using git for source code control, preferably Gitlab * Good communication and presentation skills in English \- written and verbal * Strong organization skills and ability to effectively manage multiple tasks at one time * Collaborative teammate with good interpersonal skills * Ability to work independently and manage time effectively **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience programming for the electric power systems domain is a plus * Familiarity with electric power systems planning and simulation tools is a plus * Experience with machine learning, workflow automation, and large language models, using tools such as PyTorch * Experience with large code bases for engineering tools * Demonstrated experience delivering projects that bring value for customers * Experience working in the Power Systems industry, at a utility, vendor, or regulator **Create a better \#TomorrowWithUs** **About Siemens:** We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource\-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. **Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:** We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. \#GSWUS $100,450 $206,640 10\-15%

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Stratus, deriving from the Latin term meaning 'layer', offers an advanced set of MEP specific solutions that seamlessly layer across a contractor's entire workflow from design to fabrication to installation. Our team of seasoned industry experts, skilled technology leaders, innovators, and entrepreneurs understands that fabrication does not occur in isolation, and increasingly, it may not happen within your own fabrication shop. Through close relationships with our customers—who include some of the most innovative and largest MEP contractors—we have developed a suite of Stratus tools to digitize, automate, and optimize piping, plumbing, sheet metal, and electrical contracting. Stratus provides the software layer an MEP Contractor needs to optimize profits with true "Data Driven Contracting." **GENERAL DESCRIPTION:** The Senior Site Reliability Engineer is accountable for how Stratus behaves in production. Reporting to the Senior Director, Platform Engineering, this role brings genuine SRE discipline to a platform that MEP contractors run their fabrication shops on — where downtime does not mean a degraded experience, it means work stops on a job site. Stratus is a \~50\-person, primarily remote, Series B software company growing quickly. Unrelenting Reliability is one of our company values, and this is the role that operationalizes it. You will define what reliable means in numbers, instrument the system so we can see it, and close the loop from production signal back into engineering priority. This is an engineering role with a production mandate: you will write code, tune queries, build alerting, run load tests, and lead incidents — and you will be measured on customer\-visible availability and latency, not on tickets closed. The load\-bearing problems on your plate are: (1\) establishing service level objectives and an error budget the whole engineering organization operates against, with the measurement infrastructure to back them; (2\) building the detection and response capability — high\-signal alerting, clear on\-call and escalation paths, per\-system incident ownership, and well\-exercised recovery paths — so that production problems are caught and resolved fast; and (3\) building the performance and capacity engineering practice for our data and messaging layers, with headroom measured rather than assumed. You will work across every engineering pod, with our platform and security functions, and with the customer\-facing teams who see reliability problems first. The right candidate is comfortable being the person who says a number out loud and defends it, and is drawn to a place where the reliability practice is being built rather than maintained. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Define and own service level indicators, objectives, and error budgets for customer\-facing services; build the measurement pipeline that makes them trustworthy and publish availability and latency against target on a regular cadence. * Build and own production observability: instrumentation standards, dashboards, and actionable alerting on our stack — AKS on Azure, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Grafana, with Istio as the service mesh and Flux for GitOps — extending coverage across every environment. * Establish and run incident response practice — on\-call rotation and paging paths, severity definitions, per\-system incident ownership, escalation into and out of customer support, and blameless post\-mortems in incident.io. * Set the recovery standard: define what rollback and recovery must demonstrate, and verify through regular exercise that every service meets it. * Lead performance and capacity engineering: query and index tuning, connection\-pool sizing, capacity modeling against real load, and designing for graceful degradation under partial failure. * Work with the existing team that runs our k6 load, stress, spike, and soak testing against a production\-like environment; help set per\-endpoint latency thresholds tied to our SLOs and make the results a gate on delivery. * Drive production readiness: review new services and significant changes against readiness criteria covering instrumentation, alerting, failure modes, resource limits, and rollback before they ship. * Close the loop on remediation: track post\-mortem action items through to verified production change. * Contribute to business continuity and disaster recovery planning, including backup and restore validation, failover design, and recovery objectives. * Partner with engineering pods to push reliability ownership outward — coach teams on instrumenting and operating their own services. * Write code: tooling, automation, instrumentation libraries, and fixes in the production codebase. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 6\+ years of professional engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years in a dedicated SRE or production engineering role at a B2B SaaS company. * Demonstrated ownership of SLOs and error budgets in production — you have defined them, measured them, argued about them with product leadership, and changed engineering behavior with them. * Deep, practical observability skills with Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Grafana or comparable: you have instrumented real systems and built alerting that pages on customer impact rather than on CPU. * Hands\-on incident command experience at meaningful severity, including building on\-call and escalation practice from the ground up. * Strong database performance skills — query profiling, index design, connection pooling, and diagnosing saturation under load. MongoDB experience strongly preferred; comparable document or relational depth acceptable. * Production Kubernetes experience (AKS preferred) sufficient to debug a live problem — pod scheduling, resource limits, networking, and service mesh behavior (Istio preferred). * Solid coding ability in at least one general\-purpose language (Go, Python, C\#, or TypeScript); willingness to work in a C\#/.NET codebase. * Experience with load and performance testing tooling (k6, JMeter, Gatling, or comparable) and with turning results into engineering priority. * Production experience on Azure or AWS, with real understanding of the failure modes of managed services. * Fluency with AI\-assisted engineering tooling and a track record of designing AI\-leveraged workflows for your team — this is a graded expectation at every level at Stratus. * Excellent written communication: you write post\-mortems, runbooks, and reliability reports that executives and engineers both read and act on. * Judgment and steadiness under pressure, and the credibility to tell engineering and product leadership something they do not want to hear. **NICE TO HAVE:** * Experience establishing or maturing an SRE practice — defining the discipline, not inheriting it. * Experience with Sentry or comparable application error\-monitoring platforms. * Experience operating event\-driven and real\-time systems — message brokers (Azure Service Bus, Kafka) and websocket or push layers (SignalR or comparable). * Experience operating MongoDB Atlas at production scale, including replica set topology and Atlas performance tooling. * Experience with durable workflow orchestration (Temporal or comparable). * Background in multi\-region or multi\-zone architecture and DR design against stated recovery objectives. * Experience with incident.io, PagerDuty, or comparable incident management platforms. * Familiarity with DORA metrics and with reliability work inside SOC 2 or NIST 800\-171 scope. * Experience with legacy monolith reliability — improving the operational behavior of an ASP.NET or comparable application you cannot rewrite. * Domain interest in MEP, BIM, AEC, or construction technology. * Prior experience in a Series B / growth\-stage company navigating the transition from product\-market fit to scale. **BENEFITS:** * Comprehensive and competitive health benefits plan * Matching 401k contributions * 20 days annual PTO * Primarily remote work with occasional annual team onsites. E\-VERIFY STATEMENT *Stratus* *participates* *in E\-Verify. After you join the team,* *we'll* *verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by* *submitting* *information from your Form I\-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post\-hire only* *\-* *we never use E\-Verify to pre\-screen applicants.* E\-Verify Notice Right to Work Notice

Qualifications and Skills * Proficiency with design software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation, and Solid Works \- preferred, but not required * Proficiency in Microsoft Office such as Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams * Ability to work collaboratively with others, including, but not limited to: Project Managers, Engineers, and other Tech/Designers * Knowledge of electrical design, calculations, and design systems is a plus * Experience working with electrical distribution systems is a plus * Excellent written \& verbal communication skills * Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to handle multiple tasks * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, and attention to detail **Education and Experience Requirements:** * High School Diploma or GED equivalent * Associate's Degree in Drafting / Design Technology (or similar) is preferred, but not required * Microsoft Office Suite (emphasis on Excel) Employee Benefits * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance * 401K with Company match * Paid Time Off (PTO) * 9 Paid Company Holidays Physical Requirements * Prolonged sitting and standing are required * Ability to occasionally lift, pull, carry, and push items weighing up to 50 pounds * Ability to handle stressful situations in a calm and courteous manner * Requires working under some stressful conditions to meet deadlines and Company needs Environmental/Working Conditions * Works in a routine office environment; in\-office setting * Ability to work extended hours, as needed * Travel will be required at a minimum of 20% of the time Candidates must have a valid driver’s license and a clear driving record. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, which may include verification of driving history, criminal records, and other relevant factors. \#TS25

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer 2

This role reports to a Manager, Technical Support. This position requires working in a shift. (Mon\-Fri, Tue\-Sat or Sun\-Thu). **Responsibilities** In this role, you’ll: * WEAR THE CUSTOMER’S SHOES: Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams. * Be ready to assist our customers when they need us. (MUA)**and **Message Transfer Agents (MTA)**. * Solid knowledge of **REST APIs**, API troubleshooting, and cloud\-based solutions. * Good understanding of internet security and communication protocols, including **SSL, TLS, and SMTP**. * Strong troubleshooting skills for network connectivity issues, with a good understanding of **TCP/UDP**, **SSL/TLS**, and general networking concepts. * Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences via phone and email. * Customer\-first mindset with a demonstrated commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Strong ability to prioritize tasks, assess business impact, and respond with appropriate urgency. * Demonstrated accountability by taking ownership of customer issues and driving them to resolution. * Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently and proactively without requiring constant supervision. * Strong focus on execution, with the ability to prioritize and complete key objectives before taking on new initiatives. * Leverage Twilio's AI tools and other automations to assist and efficiently communicate with customers * Experience participating in incident management, incident communications, and on\-call rotations. * Technical expertise: Supporting Email REST APIs, Splunk, Command\-line tools and terminal environments, JIRA and Confluence (preferred) **Desired:** * Advanced time management skills, ability to work well under pressure, and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures. * Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organization. * Interest in utilizing customer feedback to identify and drive improvements in our products. * Basic understanding of Curl command, Webhook. * Basic SQL knowledge to query data from snowflake * Experience with SFDC, QuickBooks, Zuora or other financial management software and financial principles a plus for some roles (Billing), Postman or other APIs client, Zendesk. **Location** This role will be based remotely in India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi) **Travel** We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in\-person meetings. **What We Offer** Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. jobs.title: Business Development & Proposals Manager
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Twin Peaks, Inc., a construction materials testing and special inspections firm, is seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented **Business Development \& Proposals Manager** to support strategic growth across the New York metropolitan and broader tri\-state region. This is a hybrid role spanning business development, proposal preparation, pricing coordination, and commercial review support. The position is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, responding to requests for proposals, preparing quotations and pricing packages, supporting contract renewals and task orders, and coordinating internal handoff after contract execution. The Business Development \& Proposals Manager will work closely with executive leadership, project management, accounting, HR, operations, and sales to help expand Twin Peaks’ client base and maintain a strong pipeline of meaningful public\- and private\-sector opportunities. The ideal candidate is organized, commercially minded, adaptable, and capable of handling sensitive pricing and contractual information with a high degree of discretion. **Key Responsibilities** Identify, track, and pursue business opportunities in the construction, special inspections, and construction materials testing sectors throughout the tri\-state area Build and maintain relationships with developers, general contractors, construction managers, owners, consultants, engineers, and architects Prepare and submit proposals, bids, qualifications packages, and related procurement responses for public and private clients Respond to solicitations issued by city, state, and federal agencies, as well as regional authorities, institutions, and private\-sector clients Prepare and provide quotations for prospective customers, subject to executive pricing review prior to submission Manage contract renewals, amendments, and initiation of new task orders under existing agreements Maintain familiarity with government and procurement platforms, including but not limited to NYC PASSPort, NYSCR, and Bonfire Monitor and maintain a schedule of upcoming major regional development projects and procurement opportunities Conduct outreach and cold solicitation efforts related to major development projects and prospective client accounts Maintain and manage the company’s opportunity pipeline using existing internal tracking tools, currently maintained in Excel, and adapt to future CRM workflows as the company expands its in\-house ERP and CRM capabilities Coordinate with project management and accounting following contract execution to support smooth operational and financial handoff Report regularly to the CEO regarding pipeline activity, bid status, opportunity tracking, and business development performance Maintain strict confidentiality regarding internal pricing structures, billing rates, labor rates, and related commercial information Gather and assemble submission materials, including insurance documents, certifications, forms, compliance documentation, resumes, and project sheets Draft, revise, and tailor employee and firm resumes, qualifications statements, and project sheets for specific bid packages, with training and collaboration from HR, Operations, and other internal stakeholders as needed Review solicitation and contract materials sufficiently to identify key commercial terms, including pay\-when\-paid provisions, payment terms, and insurance requirements that may require advance planning or procurement of additional coverage Support the preparation of pricing structures and commercial proposals in coordination with executive leadership and, as applicable, the finance team Collaborate with the Sales Executive on quotations and opportunities developed through direct lead generation efforts Ensure that all formal pricing submissions and quotations are reviewed by the CEO prior to release Occasionally attend client visits, pre\-bid meetings, outreach events, or related business development functions as needed **Qualifications** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Construction Management, Public Administration, Engineering, or related field preferred **3\+ years** of business development, proposal coordination, government contracting, or related experience preferred Experience in special inspections, construction materials testing, engineering, government procurement, or related construction industry environments strongly preferred Familiarity with government contracting and procurement systems, including NYC PASSPort, NYSCR, and Bonfire, strongly preferred Strong writing, editing, and document preparation skills Ability to prepare professional proposals, qualifications packages, customized resumes, project sheets, and compliance materials with minimal oversight Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines, pursuits, and submission requirements simultaneously Ability to identify key commercial and insurance\-related contract provisions for internal review Adaptability and comfort learning new systems and technologies, including future CRM tools and internal ERP\-based workflows Professional judgment, discretion, and ability to handle highly confidential commercial information Strong interpersonal and communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook Positive attitude, professionalism, and ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment **Performance Expectations** The primary performance metric for this role is **contract value won**, with an emphasis on securing meaningful, scalable project opportunities rather than small\-volume contracts that create disproportionate administrative overhead. **Work Environment** This is a full\-time, in\-office position based in Long Island City, NY. The business environment is professional but relaxed, and the successful candidate should contribute positively to team cohesion while maintaining a high standard of accountability, discretion, and professionalism. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Twin Peaks, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer, Business Operations
jobs.description: TwinFocus is a Boston\-based, fast\-growing, family office and investment advisory firm that was founded in 2006\. Our firm delivers highly bespoke investment, financial and planning solutions for sophisticated and complex client situations. More information on TwinFocus can be found on our website: www.twinfocus.com. **THE ROLE** We are seeking a hands\-on AI Automation Engineer to design, build, and deploy intelligent automation tools that support the day\-to\-day operations of a growing multi\-family office. This role is focused on improving operational efficiency by automating manual administrative workflows, enhancing data accessibility, and helping teams work more effectively through practical AI solutions. The ideal candidate is highly technical, execution focused, and passionate about building tools that solve real business problems. This role is not centered on AI research or quantitative trading strategies. Instead, the focus is on operational automation, workflow orchestration, document intelligence, and enterprise AI enablement within a highly regulated environment. CRM, Asana, Addepar, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. **WHAT YOU WILL OWN** • Design and deploy AI powered workflows that reduce manual administrative work across family office operations * Automate operational processes related to money movement tracking, account opening workflows, tax preparation checklists, document routing, and client onboarding * Build intelligent systems that organize, classify, summarize, and make historical firm documents searchable through LLM powered interfaces * Develop integrations and workflow automations across Wealthbox CRM, Asana, SharePoint, Addepar, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and other internal platforms * Create internal AI tools that assist employees with document retrieval, memo drafting, task tracking, invoice processing, and operational reporting * Automate recurring client communications, operational summaries, and internal reporting workflows * Help establish centralized and searchable data structures that improve the firm's ability to retrieve institutional knowledge and historical records * Identify opportunities for AI adoption and recommend new tools, system enhancements, and workflow improvements that support long term operational scalability * Assist in expanding the firm’s Microsoft based AI ecosystem using Azure, Copilot, Power Automate, Power BI, Teams, and SharePoint integrations * Ensure all automation systems are secure, auditable, compliant, and designed with strong governance and human oversight **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** Required * 2–5 years of software engineering, automation engineering, or AI systems experience with strong Python proficiency * Hands\-on experience building with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or similar platforms * Experience building AI powered workflows, automation systems, or internal operational tools in production environments * Strong understanding of API integrations, workflow orchestration, and document processing pipelines * Experience working with Microsoft technologies such as Azure, SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, or Power BI * Experience programmatically working with Excel, PDFs, CSVs, and operational datasets * Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate directly with non\-technical business users * Ability to independently identify inefficiencies and build practical solutions with minimal oversight * Strong appreciation for security, auditability, and data governance in regulated environments Preferred * Experience with workflow automation frameworks, AI agent orchestration tools, or retrieval augmented generation (RAG) architectures * Familiarity with systems such as Wealthbox, Addepar, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, or similar operational platforms * Experience building enterprise search or knowledge management solutions powered by LLMs * Exposure to OCR, document extraction, invoice processing, or records management systems * Experience working in financial services, wealth management, family office, accounting, or other highly regulated industries * Familiarity with SEC regulated environments, operational controls, and data privacy best practices * Comfort working in a small, collaborative environment with significant ownership and autonomy **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** Within your first 30 days, you will have mapped core operational workflows and delivered your first production automation that reduces repetitive manual work. Within 90 days, you will have deployed AI enabled workflows that improve operational efficiency around document management, task tracking, and administrative processes. Within 6 months, you will have materially improved the firm’s ability to automate family office operations, retrieve institutional knowledge, and securely leverage AI across internal systems and historical data repositories.
