jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing...** You will be building, optimizing, and deploying state\-of\-the\-art agentic AI/ML models and systems within the Verizon Consumer Group (VCG) AI team. Applying hands\-on technical expertise, you will be implementing next\-generation customer success, sales, and digital agent solutions that directly impact how millions of customers interact with Verizon. Working as part of a high\-performing squad, you will turn architectural designs into production\-grade code while ensuring reliability, performance, and scale. Responsibilities include: * Developing, testing, and scaling agentic AI/ML solutions, specialized workflows, and LLM\-powered systems for Verizon Consumer Group platforms. * Integrating AI agent frameworks with existing customer success, digital, and retail channel technologies. * Collaborating with product managers and engineering teams to implement and iterate on production\-grade technical roadmaps. * Participating in engineering code reviews, technical design sessions, and red\-teaming exercises to ensure safe and reliable model behaviors. * Optimizing model inference pipelines, API endpoints, and data integration layers to meet high\-performance consumer demands. * Assisting in technical research and rapid prototyping to quickly evaluate and implement emerging open\-source and proprietary AI frameworks. * Contributing to the documentation of technical specifications and creating materials to showcase pilot performance results. ### **What we’re looking for...** You thrive on working with complex data and translating it into scalable solutions. Detail\-oriented and driven by high\-impact outcomes, you prioritize data quality, model precision, and rigorous evaluation. You are a self\-driven engineer who can architect pipelines and deploy models independently under tight timelines, always focused on leveraging AI to directly enhance customer experiences . **You will need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * One or more years of hands\-on experience building, tuning, or integrating AI/ML models and LLM applications. * Experience within Agile software development methodologies. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field. * Experience developing end\-to\-end AI agents and RAG architectures using orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Google ADK). * Hands\-on experience with cloud\-native technologies, API design, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Familiarity with enterprise AI integrations and performance management platforms (e.g., Verint). * Strong prioritization skills with a track record of managing multiple projects in fast\-paced environments. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $120,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Senior BI Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- The **Enterprise BI \& Analytics Team** is the central hub of analytics and data engineering at WebstaurantStore. We transform **billions of data points** across marketing, supply chain, operations, and customer experience into trusted data foundations and actionable insights. Leveraging a **modern data stack**, scalable cloud technologies, and innovative DataOps practices, the team empowers smarter decisions, rapid growth, and new opportunities across the business. As a **Senior BI Engineer**, you will architect and own the next generation of our enterprise data ingestion ecosystem. You will lead the creation of a unified ingestion framework into Snowflake—building scalable, repeatable, and high performance patterns that power analytics and data products across the organization. You will guide our transition from SQL Server to Snowflake, mentor engineers, establish engineering best practices, and collaborate closely with stakeholders to deliver reliable, enterprise grade data solutions. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Senior BI Engineers are technical leaders and trusted partners** to BI developers, analysts, and cross functional teams. You will shape the future of our data platform by driving ingestion architecture, building modern pipelines, and enabling high impact engineering capabilities across the business. Key areas of ownership include: **Data Engineering \& Architecture** * Lead the design, development, and implementation of a standardized data ingestion framework into Snowflake. * Architect scalable, secure, and reusable ingestion patterns for diverse data sources, including APIs, databases, cloud storage, flat files, and SharePoint. * Build and maintain Fabric Pipelines to support enterprise grade data movement and orchestration. * Develop Python based ingestion utilities, automation scripts, and reusable components. * Establish best practices for ingestion performance, error handling, logging, and monitoring. * Analyze existing ingestion processes and drive modernization, consolidation, and optimization efforts. * Support and guide the organization through the transition from SQL Server to Snowflake. **Leadership \& Team Enablement** * Serve as the technical lead for data ingestion initiatives, providing direction, mentorship, and oversight to BI developers. * Delegate work effectively and coach team members on ingestion patterns, frameworks, and best practices. * Conduct code reviews, provide architectural guidance, and ensure adherence to engineering standards. * Collaborate with BI Managers to align resources, timelines, and priorities. * Promote a culture of knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. **Planning, Analysis \& Delivery** * Partner with analysts and business stakeholders to understand ingestion requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. * Lead the planning, design, and analysis of ingestion workflows and data engineering projects. * Evaluate new data sources and determine optimal ingestion strategies. * Contribute to long term architectural roadmaps and data platform strategy. * Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for data quality, governance, and security. **Agile / Scrum Responsibilities** * Lead or actively participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives. * Collaborate with product owners, analysts, and developers to refine and prioritize the backlog. * Track team progress, identify risks, and remove blockers to maintain delivery momentum. * Communicate status, challenges, and dependencies to BI Managers and stakeholders. **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- * Work is performed while sitting/standing and interfacing with a personal computer. * Requires the ability to communicate effectively using speech, vision, and hearing. * Requires the regular use of hands for simple grasping and fine manipulations. * Requires occasional bending, squatting, crawling, climbing, and reaching. * Requires the ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull medium weights, up to 50lbs. **Remote Work Qualifications** ------------------------------ * Access to a reliable and secure high\-speed internet connection. Cable or fiber internet connections (at least 75mbps download/10mbps upload) are preferred, as satellite connections often cannot support the technologies used to perform day\-to\-day tasks. * Access to a home router and modem. * A dedicated home office space that is noise\- and distraction\-free. The space should have strong wireless connection or a wired Ethernet connection (wired connection is preferred, if possible). * A valid, physical address (apartment, suite, etc.). PO Boxes are not supported, as a physical address is required for you to receive your computer equipment. * The desire and ability to work and communicate with other team members via chat, webcam, etc. * Legal residents of one of the following states: (AK, AL, AR, AZ, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, MT, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WI, WV, or WY). H\-1B Visa Sponsorship Not Available, W2 only. **Experience** -------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience. * **7–10 years** of professional experience in data engineering. * **5\+ years** of hands\-on experience with Snowflake, including ingestion, transformation, optimization, and platform performance tuning. * **4–6 years** of experience building data pipelines using **Microsoft Fabric Pipelines** or equivalent orchestration tools. * **4–6 years** of professional **Python** experience focused on automation, ingestion utilities, and framework development. * **5\+ years** of enterprise SQL experience, including advanced SQL Server work and **hands\-on Change Data Capture (CDC)** implementation and support. * **5\+ years** of experience working in **Agile/Scrum** environments. * **3\+ years** of experience leading data engineering initiatives or serving as a technical lead on ingestion projects. * Experience working with **event sourcing** or **data contract–driven ingestion patterns**. * Experience using **Qlik Replicate** for data movement and replication. * Experience using **dbt Cloud** for ELT transformation and orchestration. * Microsoft Azure experience * Certifications in **dbt Cloud, Snowflake**, or **Microsoft Fabric** preferred but not required. **Education** ------------- This role does not require a degree. We value relevant skills and experience and alignment with our core values above all else. **Desired Traits \& Skills** ---------------------------- * Deep expertise in building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines across diverse platforms. * Strong proficiency with Snowflake architecture, Snowflake ingestion patterns, and SQL. * Advanced Python skills for automation, ingestion utilities, and framework development. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric Pipelines or similar orchestration tools. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and ETL/ELT best practices. * Ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor team members, and influence engineering direction. * Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to design scalable solutions. * Excellent communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts for nontechnical audiences. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced environment. * High degree of adaptability, emotional intelligence, and collaborative mindset. * Customer focused approach with a commitment to delivering high quality solutions. **Company Overview** -------------------- The foodservice professional’s premier source for restaurant equipment, supplies, and knowledge online. Our purpose is to empower and equip people to run their businesses more profitably and efficiently. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical * Vision * Dental * PTO * Paid Maternity Leave * Paid Parental Leave * Life Insurance * Disability * Dependent Care FSA * 401(k) matching * Employee Assistance Program * Wellness Incentives * Company Discounts * AT\&T \& Verizon Discount * Bonus Opportunities * Accident Insurance * Critical Illness Insurance * Adoption Assistance ### **Available at HQ Locations Only** * On\-Site Fitness Centers * Dog\-friendly Offices

We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong. Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care. #### **Overview** **Position Summary:** The Senior Software Quality Engineer position is responsible to ensure that activities throughout the product lifecycle are in compliance with procedures, standards and regulations applicable to our products. In this capacity the Sr SWQE independently develops, applies and implements methods, tools and practices while working with project teams to achieve product quality goals and requirements in the areas of design, development, cybersecurity, verification and validation, maintenance and service. jobs.description: **Company Description** Worldwide TechServices is a global leader in delivering technology services and solutions to the world’s most demanding clients. Headquartered in Billerica, MA; we provide infrastructure services and professional services to the world’s leading technology providers, outsourcers, large and small businesses and consumers. **Job Description** The Customer Service Engineer \- is an intermediate position that performs tasks related to the repair of a variety of technology\-based products typically associated in an end\-user confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Mariana Tek (Remote)
jobs.description: **Company Description** Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI\-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership\-based and service\-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences. **Job Description** Mariana Tek is a leading vertical SaaS platform that enables boutique fitness studios to run their businesses with ease, save time and increase revenue. Mariana Tek empowers class\-based boutique fitness studios to increase sales performance and overall productivity by managing all aspects of their daily operations. We are looking for a **Senior Product Designer** to join our team focused on Mariana Tek, our platform designed for boutique fitness businesses. You'll create intuitive design solutions that support studios with end\-to\-end business management capabilities (spanning class scheduling, booking, inventory management, point\-of\-sale, etc.) as well as deliver world class consumer experiences. In this role, you’ll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define and execute product strategies that align with user needs and business goals. This position offers opportunities for growth, allowing you to lead complex design initiatives while pushing the boundaries of product strategy and visual craft. **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in UX Design, with a strong portfolio showcasing successful UX/UI solutions for complex web and mobile applications. Experience in a Lead or Senior role is highly preferred. * **Design Expertise:** Mastery of design tools such as Figma (our primary tool) and Design Thinking. Proficient in creating wireframes, user flows, prototypes, high\-fidelity mockups, research questions, and user surveys. * **UX Principles:** Deep understanding of user\-centered design principles, usability heuristics, information architecture, design systems, and interaction design patterns. * **Research Acumen:** Experience conducting and synthesizing user research (interviews, usability testing, surveys) to inform design decisions. * **Technical Understanding:** Solid understanding of front\-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and the ability to communicate effectively with engineers about technical constraints and opportunities. * **Communication:** Excellent verbal, written, and visual communication skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and rationale to diverse audiences. * **Problem\-Solving:** Proven ability to break down complex problems into manageable, actionable design solutions. * **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to autonomously lead design initiatives, influence stakeholders, and mentor team members. **Bonus Skillsets** * Experience in a B2B SaaS environment. * Familiarity with the use of AI in design, research, and copy (e.g., Co\-pilot, Figma Make, Miro AI). * Proficiency in front\-end coding (e.g., HTML, CSS) for prototyping or component development. Join us in shaping the future of boutique fitness! **Additional Information** **Values and Life at Xplor** Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day: * Find a better way * Do the right thing * Say it straight * Win together * Own the outcome If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor. As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed. **Some of our perks and benefits are:** * Paid Parental Leave benefit programs * \#GiveBackDays/Commitment to social impact – 3 extra days off to volunteer and give back to your local community * Ongoing dedication to Diversity \& Inclusion initiatives such as D\&I Council, Global Mentorship Program * Access to free mental health support * Flexible working arrangements **Ready to apply?** To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Please include the word "moonshot" at the top of your message to the Hiring Manager so that we know you took the time to read our job ad. We understand that diverse candidates have diverse needs. We welcome you to inform us of any additional needs related to completing your job application or participating in the interview process, via talentsupport@xplortechnologies.com. **More about us** More than 130,000 businesses in 72\+ countries rely on Xplor to run their day and get paid, processing over $47 billion in payments annually. Our connected ecosystem helps operators spend less time managing complexity and more time delivering the experiences that matter most. Xplor is backed by world\-class investors Advent International, Battery Ventures, and Silver Lake. **Good to know** To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorized to work in the location (country) you're applying for. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We kindly ask you to apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. Please don't send your application via email. To learn more about us and our products, please visit xplor.com/careers/. We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process xplor.com/recruitment\-faqs/. **EEO and Artificial Intelligence** We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system that includes artificial intelligence enabled features to assist with the screening and assessment of job applications, such as candidate scoring or ranking. These tools support our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team following human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here. Xplor is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We're dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, and age. Applications are encouraged from all sectors of the community. **We make it a priority to respond to every applicant.** We understand that diverse candidates have diverse needs. We welcome you to inform us of any additional needs related to completing your job application or participating in the interview process, via talentsupport@xplortechnologies.com. **Before you apply** To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This applies to remote roles too, as we can only employ people who reside within Canada. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage. Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly. We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process xplor.com/recruitment\-faqs/. **Interview Recording and Background Checks** As part of our hiring process, successful candidates will be asked to complete background and identity verification checks. Many of our roles are remote, and to protect both candidates and our business from recruitment fraud, we may record video interviews during the process. We keep any recordings and related data only for as long as the hiring process is active and do not retain them afterwards. **EEO and Artificial Intelligence** We believe in transparent hiring. jobs.title: Software Engineer Manager, Shorts Creation Infra, YouTube
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of experience with software design and architecture. * 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. **About the job** ----------------- Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. As a part of the Shorts Creation Infrastructure team, your mission is to build the horizontal infrastructure that powers media generation (video/audio/image) and Shorts creation on YouTube. The product surfaces we serve include Shorts Creation, Effects, Posts, and YouTube Studio. In this role you will be responsible for the team and backend infrastructure that powers Remix features (both AI and non\-AI) in YouTube. You will also partner with Shorts Discovery to drive Shorts Creation. Success in this role requires a technically deep empathetic leader who can work across multiple tech stacks, teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we address, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide technical leadership on Shorts Creation projects focused on Remix features and the creation funnel. * Lead and mentor a team of backend engineers. * Facilitate alignment and clarity across teams on goals, outcomes, and timelines. * Manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. * Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance large\-scale software solutions. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Hotel Maintenance / Handy man / Grounds keeper
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are seeking a dynamic and skilled Hotel Maintenance Engineer to ensure the seamless operation and upkeep of our hotel facilities. In this vital role, you will be responsible for maintaining and repairing a wide range of building systems, ensuring guest comfort, safety, and satisfaction. Your expertise in mechanical, electrical, and facilities maintenance will help create a welcoming environment that exceeds expectations. This position offers an exciting opportunity to lead maintenance efforts, troubleshoot complex issues, and contribute to the overall excellence of our hotel operations. **Responsibilities** * Perform routine inspections and preventative maintenance on HVAC systems, plumbing, electrical wiring, lighting, and mechanical equipment to ensure optimal functioning. * Troubleshoot and repair issues related to electrical systems, lighting, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), schematics, some mechanical components with precision and efficiency. * Conduct painting tasks as needed to maintain the aesthetic appeal of the property. * Track maintenance activities, and manage inventory. * Coordinate facilities maintenance projects, including supervising contractors when necessary. * Read and interpret schematics, technical manuals, and electrical diagrams to diagnose problems accurately within the property. * Ensure compliance with safety standards set by OSHA . * Lead efforts in manufacturing industrial\-style maintenance tasks when applicable to hotel operations or renovations. * Provide exceptional customer service by addressing guest requests related to maintenance promptly and professionally. * Maintain a clean, safe work environment by adhering to health and safety regulations at all times. **Qualifications** * Proven experience in facilities maintenance or hotel engineering roles with a strong background in mechanical, electrical, plumbing systems. * Knowledge of programmable logic controllers (PLCs), schematics, electrical experience, welding techniques, and residential painting is highly desirable. * Familiarity with CMMS software for managing maintenance workflows effectively. * Ability to read technical manuals, schematics, and electrical diagrams accurately. * Strong mechanical knowledge handling power tools. * Communication skills in English for clear documentation and coordination with team members and vendors. * Ability to perform physical tasks including lifting heavy equipment, climbing ladders, and working in confined spaces safely. * Prior experience in manufacturing or industrial environments can be advantageous but is not mandatory. Join us as a Hotel Maintenance Engineer to play a key role in maintaining our high standards of quality and guest satisfaction! Your expertise will ensure our facilities operate smoothly while providing an engaging environment for both guests and staff alike. Pay: $14\.00 \- $16\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Location:** Remote \- United States (available in select states) **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Experience:** No prior professional experience required **Education:** High school diploma or equivalent **Programming Experience:** Not required **States we are open to hiring from** \- Alabama, Arkansas, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, Montana, New Hampshire, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming **Start Your Career in Technology** We're looking for curious, sharp, highly motivated people who are excited about technology and already use AI as part of how they learn, think, research, and solve problems. You don't need a computer science degree. You don't need previous professional experience. You don't even need to know how to program. What matters much more to us is **how you think, how quickly you learn, and how effectively you use the tools available to you.** If your first instinct when you don't know something is to open ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another AI tool and start figuring it out, you'll probably feel at home here. And if AI helped you survive a few homework assignments, you might already be our kind of candidate. **What We're Looking For** We're looking for someone who: * Is curious and enjoys figuring out unfamiliar problems. * Learns quickly and is comfortable teaching themselves new things. * Regularly uses AI tools to research, learn, create, analyze, or solve problems. * Can think critically about AI\-generated answers instead of blindly accepting them. * Communicates clearly and isn't afraid to ask questions. * Takes ownership of their work. * Is comfortable experimenting, making mistakes, and learning from them. * Has a high school diploma or equivalent. * Has an SAT score that can be verified as part of our hiring process, where available. Programming experience is **not required**. If you've experimented with programming, built something with AI, created a website, automated a task, or worked on your own technical project, that's a plus—but we care much more about your ability to learn than what you already know. **SAT Score Verification** Candidates who have taken the SAT will be asked to provide their SAT score and verify it using **ShowMyScore** as part of the application process. SAT scores will be considered as one part of our overall assessment alongside other job\-related qualifications. **What You'll Do** As a Trainee, you'll work alongside experienced team members while learning how a modern technology company operates. Depending on the projects you're working on, you may: * Use AI tools to research and solve real business and technical problems. * Learn how software products are designed, built, tested, and improved. * Test products and identify bugs or opportunities for improvement. * Research new technologies and AI tools. * Help create documentation and internal resources. * Work with experienced developers and other team members. * Learn programming and software\-development fundamentals. * Experiment with automation and AI\-assisted development. * Gradually take ownership of increasingly complex projects. This isn't a classroom simulation. You'll be learning by contributing to real work. **Your Career Path** This Trainee role isn't designed to push everyone down the same career path. You'll have the opportunity to learn about different parts of a growing technology company, work on real projects, and discover where your strengths and interests fit best. Over time, your career could develop in areas such as: * **Software Development \& Engineering** * **AI \& Automation** * **Marketing** * **Sales** * **Sales Operations** * **Salesforce** * **Product** * **Customer Success** * **Research \& Analytics** * or another area where your skills are a strong fit. You don't need to know which path is right for you when you join. That's part of the point of the Trainee program. As you work with different teams and take on different kinds of problems, we'll help you identify what you're good at, what you enjoy doing, and where you can make the greatest contribution. For someone interested in technology, for example, a potential path might be: **Trainee → Junior Developer → Developer → Senior Developer** Someone else might discover that they're particularly good at marketing, sales, operations, product, or another function and build their career in that direction instead. Our goal is to give strong performers opportunities to take on increasing responsibility and build a meaningful long\-term career in the area where they're best suited. Career progression and timing aren't guaranteed and will depend on individual performance, demonstrated skills, business needs, and available opportunities. **You Might Be a Great Fit If...** You've ever: * You like to build physical things using a Raspberry Pi or build things in Minecraft using a Redstone. * Used AI to teach yourself something completely new. * Asked AI to help you understand something everyone else made sound complicated. * Built something just because you wondered whether you could. * Used ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another AI tool almost every day. * Found a repetitive task and thought, “There has to be an easier way to do this.” * Started experimenting with coding even though nobody asked you to. * Gone down a research rabbit hole because you became genuinely curious about something. We don't expect you to arrive knowing everything. **We expect you to be unusually good at figuring things out.** Pay: $11\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Controls Engineer Heavy Industry
jobs.description: **While we encourage applicants to apply, we are currently unable to offer any type of sponsorship. You must be able to apply without any requirements for a sponsor.** **Overview** Join our dynamic team as a Controls Engineer specializing in heavy industry applications! This position is responsible to design, improve, modify and maintain the electrical infrastructure of the facility and its manufacturing equipment. Electrical design for new projects to support production and equipment upgrades to improve machine efficiency. **Responsibilities** * Design of facilities electrical systems. * Installation of facilities electrical systems. * Project Management from conception to Commissioning. * Start\-up systems. * Establish operation parameters of systems. * Provide training on system operation and maintenance. * Controls support of facilities and systems * Retrofit of facilities electrical systems. * Controls upgrades on existing equipment. * Environmental controls. * Energy management and building control. * Assist maintenance staff in troubleshooting equipment/systems. **Skills** * High competency to program PLCs * Excellent troubleshooting skills * AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, RS Logix * Factory Talk View, SAP **Qualifications** * Bachalor's degree Electrical Engineering * 4\-7 years experience * Knowledge of both power systems and control systems * Highly flexible with good organizational skills and the ability to multi\-task. * Proven expertise in designing electrical systems, circuit design, schematic creation, and PCB layout using CAD software such as AutoCAD or Revit. * Hands\-on experience with FPGA development using VHDL or SystemVerilog; familiarity with simulation tools like MATLAB/Simulink is highly desirable. * Strong knowledge of control systems including programming PLCs. * Skilled in electronics design practices including surface mount technology (SMT), soldering techniques, firmware development, and electronics troubleshooting. * Experience working with industrial automation components such as sensors, vision inspection systems, motor drives, and communication protocols for industrial environments. * Ability to perform root cause analysis efficiently using diagnostic tools like oscilloscopes and multimeters; excellent debugging skills are essential. * Knowledge of electrical safety standards including NFPA 70 compliance; understanding mechanical concepts related to surface mount technology and mechanical integration is a plus. * Proficiency in scripting languages like Python or Perl for automation tasks; familiarity with C\+\+ for system development verification is advantageous. Join our team here at SGL Morganton as we move towards a bright future. Relo packages are available. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Referral program * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Experience: * Controls: 4 years (Required) Work Location: In person
